## v3.66.322 -- BEH-1 + BEH-2: canonical creation-time defaults for min_resolution and max_concurrent (Phase 4 gap closure, cut A0; backend-only, NON-guard, NO new route). The legacy Add-Site form stored min_resolution=1080 and max_concurrent=2 into a new site's config at create time; the SPA Add-Site wizard stores no defaults, so SPA-added sites fall back to the runner's read-time defaults. Those defaults diverged: runner.py read min_resolution with two different fallbacks -- get("min_resolution", 0) on the yt-dlp quality-hint path and get("min_resolution", 1080) on the runtime min-resolution gate -- so a site with no explicit min_resolution got low-res needs-review flagging silently OFF on whichever path ran first (the 0 fallback disables it). BEH-2 is the same shape for max_concurrent (one read defaulted 1, the others 2 -- a throughput-only divergence). Fix: two module constants DEFAULT_MIN_RESOLUTION=1080 and DEFAULT_MAX_CONCURRENT=2 (the legacy-stored values) that every read site references, so a missing key resolves identically everywhere. An explicit min_resolution: 0 still means "no minimum" -- the `or 0` tail preserves the operator opt-out; only the absent-key default changed. Five read sites unified (two min_resolution, three max_concurrent); the cluster_rate_max_concurrent key and the worker-affinity logic are untouched. NOTE on behavior: existing sites with no stored min_resolution will now flag sub-1080 items for review on the quality-hint path as well (this matches the legacy default and is the intended correctness fix). RED-first tests/test_v3_66_322_resolution_concurrency_defaults (5: constant values, no-zero/no-one fallback, resolution semantics). Runner-behavioral regression 88/88. 3-part bump 321->322. Guards 7/7 byte-identical (runner.py is not a guard); DEPENDENCY_GRAPH/FUNCTION_INDEX unchanged (constants, not functions; no import edge, no route).

## v3.66.321 -- data-layer import-path fix + struct_embed guarded tie-breaker (NON-guard; NO new route). Two slices. (A) FIX: the /api/data/template_health endpoint (and every sibling data-layer collector) raised "No module named 'template_inventory'" on the first hit in a fresh process. Cause: the collectors import their tools modules as `import tools.template_core` (needs the repo root on sys.path), but those tools modules use CLI-style bare sibling imports (`import template_inventory`) that need tools/ ITSELF on the path; app_data_layer._ensure_path() only added the repo root. Fix: _ensure_path() now also inserts tools/, so the bare sibling imports resolve. Resolves template_health/capture_analytics/capture_diagnostics/replay_validation alike, and restores the additive F3.3 canary block on the template_health payload. RED-first tests/test_v3_66_321_data_layer_path (2) drives a clean subprocess with only the repo root on the path (the in-process suite never caught it because tools/ was already on sys.path by then); data-layer suite 14/14. (B) AI-6 promotion: struct_embed graduates from a purely advisory field to an OPT-IN tie-breaker via detect(..., struct_tiebreak=False). Default OFF means byte-identical 320 behaviour for every existing caller (zero drift by construction). When ON and the rule recognizer is left with a genuine 2-way tie -- the top two eligible candidates in the SAME policy tier with scores within 0.05, and NEITHER storage-confirmed -- and the structural verdict is high-confidence and names one of the two, the tie is broken toward that pick. It can only re-rank the two tied candidates: it never invents a family the rules did not surface, never reaches past the top-2, and never overrides a storage tell. RED-first tests/test_v3_66_321_struct_tiebreak (10); zero-drift flag-OFF holds the recognizer pins (69/69 + 134/134). The operator switch (env/GUI) is deferred to a parity-clean follow-on so config_parity stays open=0. DEPENDENCY_GRAPH unchanged (the player_struct_embed edge already existed @320); FUNCTION_INDEX unchanged (app.py/runner.py untouched); no route, no tools-census change. (C) RELEASE TOOLING: tools/diff_release_zips.forbidden_artifacts now exempts redacted recognizer fixtures (tests/fixtures/**/*.redacted.wacz, F2-scrubbed names/shapes only) from the .wacz forbidden rule, so the baseline diff + frontend-regression hygiene gates can run WITH --baseline while the operator-confirmed vidstack fixtures ship; a real (non-.redacted) .wacz anywhere, or any .wacz outside tests/fixtures/, stays forbidden (F2-LOCAL posture for real captures unchanged). Previously the gate hard-failed on every shipped .wacz, forcing baseline-less builds that dropped the hygiene gates. RED-first tests/test_v3_66_321_diff_gate_fixture_exempt (3); hygiene suites 34/34. 3-part bump 320->321. Guards 7/7 byte-identical (NON-guard).

## v3.66.320 -- AI-6 structural-embedding player classifier + synthetic_tests json_path/canary (NON-guard). Two slices. (A) AI-6 classifier-build: FR-AI6's corpus-volume gate having cleared 17/17, this builds the structural-embedding classifier. New tools/player_struct_embed.py -- an F2-safe structural fingerprint (counts/names/shapes only: class-prefix, custom-element, storage-key-prefix, script-host histograms + video/hls/dash presence flags; never an attribute value, token, or URL), a player-namespace focus transform (prepare() restricts class features to the recognizer's brand namespaces + log-TF) that recovers cosine separation on real ~1MB DOMs, a nearest-centroid cosine classifier, and a leave-one-DOMAIN-out evaluator (binding metric = distinct domains, not captures). Trained centroids baked to tools/data/player_struct_centroids.json (18 families; media_chrome EXCLUDED -- its 3 domains are all-Mux, zero independent, cannot generalize). Validation over the consolidated corpus (250 wacz -> 127 distinct domains, one representative/domain): leave-one-domain-out accuracy 0.636, intra-cosine 0.312 vs inter-cosine 0.069 (separation +0.243, ~2x the primitive's validated margin). Wired into player_recognition.detect() as an ADDITIVE struct_embed field (family/score/margin/confidence) computed after the rule verdict in a guarded block -- a non-authoritative complement that can NEVER mutate player_family. No-drift full sweep: zero pristine-vs-wired drift across all 86 detect-sourced domains; recognizer regression pins 67/67; recognizer-consuming suites 113/113 (the additive key breaks no consumer). RED-first tests/test_v3_66_320_player_struct_embed (10). (B) synthetic_tests json_path + canary: extend the canary harness with a _json_path evaluator (dotted / [N] index / [*] wildcard) so JSON HAR fixtures assert into items[].media_url/title/id instead of passing vacuously; run_fixture exposes extracted; run_all gains a root= kwarg for sandbox-targeted replay. Four canary HAR fixtures added under fixtures/fixturesite2_* (synthetic mock-site, embedded bodies, no secrets) with real assertions; offline replay + drift detection green. RED-first tests/test_v3_66_320_synthetic_json_path (6). DEPENDENCY_GRAPH regenerated (new player_recognition -> player_struct_embed edge). Guards 7/7 byte-identical (NON-guard).

## v3.66.318 -- vidstack-over-hls recognition fix (NON-guard, tools/player_recognition.py): a real vidstack site (miruro.tv) shipping the DEFAULT layout -- no literal <media-player> element, vds- class density ~950-1149, the vidstack-*.js bundle, vds-player: localStorage -- on hls.js was misclassified: the 1232w capture scored plyr 1.0 over vidstack 0.9 (vidstack's default skin reuses plyr-ish control classes plyr__controls/data-plyr), and the vds-player: storage prefix never confirmed vidstack (the marker matched only ^vidstack[:_-] / vidstack::). Two-part fix: (1) extend _STORAGE_CONFIRMS["vidstack"] with ^vds-player[:_-] so the real runtime keys confirm the engine via the storage channel; (2) on STRONG vidstack evidence (vds- density >= 100 AND its own script and/or a vds-player: storage marker) demote the confusable co-firers {hlsjs, plyr} below vidstack so it wins -- density-gated so a faint incidental vds- trace with no script and no vds-player: storage does NOT promote (optimizely.com stays native_custom). RED-first tests/test_v3_66_318_vidstack_over_hls (6 tests; both miruro captures classify vidstack, backed by vds-player: storage / vidstack script, never by <media-player>) plus the two operator-confirmed redacted miruro fixtures. No-drift gate: a full 250-wacz consolidated-corpus sweep flips ONLY miruro.tv (plyr->vidstack); vidstack.io and tiny4k.com hold vidstack and every plyr/hls.js/media_chrome site holds. miruro.tv is vidstack's 3rd distinct domain (with vidstack.io + tiny4k.com) -> AI-6 17/17. Guards 7/7 byte-identical (NON-guard).

## v3.66.302 -- REC-3 autoplay-window guard (Fork A + Fork B) + cross-origin N-step login flow + GUI-parity inventory reconcile (NON-guard; NO route, NO frontend, NO app/runner change). One consolidated cut, all RED-first. THREE logical changes:

(1) REC-3 autoplay-window guard, BOTH forks. Problem: `_download_trigger_from_timeline` trusted a download-affordance click's `effect.direct_media >= 1`, but on an autoplay/preview site the player's stream is already in flight inside the 2500 ms correlation window, so `correlate_timeline` buckets that carry-over media onto the first operator click and the builder seeds a FALSE trigger. FORK B (capture-side attribution, `bulk_downloader/inspect_pick.py`, NON-guard -- inspect_pick is not a release guard, `tools/capture_session.py` UNTOUCHED): new per-click effect-attribution emitting `{autoplay, fresh_download}` -- `autoplay` = media was already in flight BEFORE the click (a preview/autoplay stream the click did not cause), `fresh_download` = a NEW media/manifest/direct response began AFTER the click. This is the effect-attribution the builder needed to tell carry-over from cause. FORK A (builder guard, `tools/build_template_from_wacz.py`): `_download_trigger_from_timeline(action_timeline, network_log=None)` now skips a candidate whose direct media is `autoplay and not fresh_download` via `_autoplay_contaminated()`. Legacy captures whose effect predates the new keys get the attribution BACK-COMPUTED from the passed `network_log` + the click `ts` (both on the same epoch-ms clock the capture stamps), so the guard also protects the existing capture corpus, not only 302+ captures; with neither the keys nor a network_log/ts it never fabricates a rejection (returns False). On a real download the triggered media arrives AFTER the click -> `fresh_download=True` -> retained; only autoplay/preview media already in flight before the click (`autoplay and not fresh_download`) is rejected. Structure-only, F2 (no URL/value crosses the boundary; classification by kinds/counts/timestamps).

(2) Cross-origin N-step login flow (general, not 2-step-limited). The single-form `do_login` model (user_field/pass_field/submit_btn on one page) could not express step-1 -> Next -> (possibly cross-origin IdP nav) -> step-2 password -> submit. NEW `login_flow_recorder.plan_login_flow(bundle, username=...)` derives a general N-step plan from a recorded flow (type/click steps + an inserted `await_url` at every origin hop; single-origin flows get NO await; the credential field resolves to a VAULT MARKER, never the secret -- F2); `replay_saved_login_flow(page, config)` (`bulk_downloader/login.py`) drives it across origins, run BEFORE the single-form selector cascade when a saved flow exists for the site. The recorder/replay substrate (`login_flow_recorder.py`, `macro_recorder.py`, `macro_replay.py`) was extended (pre-existing modules). The plan derivation is fully unit-tested offline; the live cross-origin browser DRIVE is live-on-stash verification (not sandbox-testable, network off).

(3) GUI-parity inventory reconcile. `reports/gui_parity_inventory.{json,md}` regenerated from the pinned 1098 baseline to the live census 1107 (the .json AND .md as a matched pair -- the standing footgun). The +9 = 7 tools genuinely present in tools/ but absent from the pinned baseline (build_session_pack, legacy_pin_scan, make_overlay, precut_check, tasktracker_gen, tasktracker_sync, build_recognizer_corpus) + the 2 routes added @293 (api_template_capture_cancel, cockpit.api_capture_goto). Clears the standing GUI-parity drift carried since 292. GATED-BLUEPRINT COUNTS UNCHANGED (data_layer 14 / report_center 9 / actions_center 10) -> G12 stays green; spa_wired 288->289 (the cancel route's card literal; the cockpit goto is /cockpit, not /api). No route was ADDED this cut; this only refreshes the shipped artifact to reflect routes/tools already present.

Tests (RED-first -> GREEN, all proven RED on pristine 301): NEW tests/test_v3_66_302_rec3_autoplay.py (Fork A rejects autoplay-contaminated click / unaffected with no autoplay signal; Fork B flags an autoplay stream / passes a genuine fresh download), tests/test_v3_66_302_login_flow_nstep.py (general N-step derivation; await inserted at origin hop; single-origin no await; plan resolves a vault marker not a secret), tests/test_v3_66_302_gui_parity_reconcile.py (gated-blueprint counts unchanged; shipped inventory includes the new 293 routes + reconciled tools; shipped .json matches the live regen itemset). Regression: inspect_pick/capture 66/66, login-flow/macro 108/108, builder/recognizer/corpus 58/58, gui_parity/parity/routes 40/40. Guards 7/7 byte-identical (re-derived from the extracted zip; capture_session UNCHANGED). DEPENDENCY_GRAPH regenerated 766->768 (new login.py->login_flow_recorder/macro_replay edges); FUNCTION_INDEX regenerated (login.py gained replay_saved_login_flow). The capture-model characterization golden's synthetic fixture had its network timestamps aligned to realistic same-clock ordering (media AFTER the click ts=1000) -- INPUT-only; the derived trigger stays `button.dl`, proving REC-3 leaves a genuine click-triggered download untouched (it only rejects autoplay carry-over). No route added -> ENDPOINT_CATALOG / G12 gated-blueprint counts unchanged; NO frontend. 3-part bump 301->302.

## v3.66.299 -- Capture-workflow hardening: the 4 follow-up recommendations from the 6-round MAX-adversarial capture audit (recs #1-#4). All RED-first, behavior-preserving. ONE guard touched (capture_bodies, authorized); the other 6 byte-identical. #1 CONSOLIDATED DOM-WALKER DEPTH CAP (NON-guard): dom_serialize.nodes_to_html, dom_analyzer._mask_all_text/_propagate_mask, and the builder's _node_to_html/_walk_node recursed once per DOM nesting level with no bound -- a deeply-nested node tree (an old/external capture predating the export truncation cap, or operator-pasted HTML) blew Python's recursion limit. They now share a depth cap (_MAX_DOM_DEPTH/_MAX_NODE_DEPTH = 400, above the ~150 real-DOM and <=250 truncated-capture ceilings; a pathological subtree is cut off instead of crashing -- real renders unchanged). #2 WACZ ZIP-BOMB CEILING (NON-guard): capture_ingest.load_capture + the builder's _load_capture read a capture.json member out of a .wacz; they now refuse a member whose DECLARED uncompressed size exceeds _MAX_CAPTURE_JSON_BYTES (256 MiB) BEFORE decompressing it (zipfile honours the declared size, so a decompression bomb must declare a large size to deliver one). A real capture.json is far below the ceiling. #3 capture_bodies JSON-BODY SIZE CAP (GUARD -- capture_bodies.py 90bb8e0f->c428c104): the text body path was capped at _MAX_TEXT_LEN but the JSON path parsed+redacted+re-serialized with no size bound (a retained JSON body was size-unlimited); redact_body now collapses an oversize JSON body (raw string over cap, OR redacted result over cap) to the length marker. NEW _MAX_JSON_LEN = 1 MiB -- deliberately larger than the 64 KiB text cap because JSON API payloads are legitimately bigger; the goal is bounding unbounded growth, not matching the byte value. Text path untouched. #4 SESSIONLESS-CSRF ORIGIN GUARD (NON-guard, app.py): _check_csrf skipped the check whenever no session cookie was present, relying on _check_token's same-origin Referer defense -- but on a no-auth-token deployment _check_token allows all (`not tok`), so a sessionless cross-origin POST to the localhost app had NO CSRF defense (the classic malicious-public-page-attacks-localhost vector). Added a same-origin Origin check (independent of session/auth): a state-changing /api/ request whose Origin is cross-origin is refused 403; same-origin / absent Origin and Bearer/CLI fall through unchanged. NEW tests (13, all RED-first -> GREEN): test_dom_walker_depth_cap (4), test_wacz_zipbomb_cap (2), test_capture_bodies_json_cap (3), test_csrf_origin_guard (4); pristine-source RED demonstrated for the deep-DOM crash. Regression clean: capture_bodies / dom_analyzer / CSRF-bootstrap / auth / token 117/117. app.py touched -> FUNCTION_INDEX regenerated; NO route added -> ENDPOINT_CATALOG / G12 / gui_parity unchanged; no new module import -> dependency_graph unchanged. NO frontend. 3-part bump 298->299.

## v3.66.296 -- D++ cut 3 (Layer C): protection tagging, recognized from the network log + cookies + page markup. DETECTION ONLY / F2 (NON-guard; player_recognition + build_template_from_wacz; NO route, NO frontend). Tags, NAMES and SHAPES only -- never a token, signed-URL, or cookie VALUE. F2 surface verified against the redactor: redact_query keeps query param NAMES (values -> PLACEHOLDER), scrub_headers keeps header NAMES (credential values dropped), script hosts are query-stripped, and the cookie jar is reduced to a PLACEHOLDER string under redaction -- so every recognizer works on a fully-redacted capture without touching a secret. Signing scheme by query-param-name fingerprint: akamai (hdnts/hdnea/__token__), CloudFront (Policy+Signature+Key-Pair-Id or Expires+Signature+Key-Pair-Id TRIPLET -- a lone Signature does not match), AWS SigV4 (X-Amz-Signature -> collects the X-Amz-* names), JWT (jwt, or exp+sig/signature), generic_token (token/expires/sig/hash on a media-ish URL or when paired, so a plain ?token= search is not flagged). token-refresh endpoints by path name (token/refresh, get_signed_url, re-sign, /auth/token, ...). Anti-bot vendor by cookie-name + request/response header-NAME + script/host marker: akamai (_abck/bm_sz/ak_bmsc), cloudflare (cf_clearance/__cf_bm; cf-ray/cf-mitigated header names; challenges.cloudflare.com), datadome (datadome cookie; x-datadome header; js.datadome.co), perimeterx (_px*; perimeterx.net/px-cdn.net), kasada (x-kpsdk-* header names; kasada), queue-it (queue-it.net host; QueueITAccepted) -- anti_bot_signals records WHICH names matched. Captcha widget (turnstile/hcaptcha/recaptcha) from markup/script with a vendor-specific marker REQUIRED, so a bare data-sitekey cross-tags nothing. DRM/EME via the existing detect_drm needles -> drm:true + license-server host SHAPES (query-stripped). Header preconditions: a gated media request (401/403) missing Referer/Origin/Range records the missing header NAMES + status + url_shape. cookie_names: names only, tolerates the redacted PLACEHOLDER jar (-> empty) without crashing. WIRE-UP: build_template recognition block now carries recognition.protection additively (existing keys unchanged); cap.cookies (PLACEHOLDER str under redaction) passed through safely. capture-model golden regenerated -- PURELY ADDITIVE (11 new protection keys, 0 removed, 0 changed). ## v3.66.293 -- Held-open capture robustness for anti-bot / signed-JWPlayer sites (A/B/C) + signed-JWPlayer auto-template recognition (D), plus CAP-CANCEL onboarding stop. FIELD BUG (operator-reported, ultrafilms = signed JWPlayer behind akamai+cloudflare): a held-open /capture session navigated to the typed deep members URL, the site auth-redirected the live session to home (the login flow dropped the deep link), anti-bot challenges blocked the content, and the session ended having captured ~2 resources -- "the site closed before I could do anything." Root cause: the held-open loop (_wait_for_finish + _pump_dom per tick) had NO recovery -- when an anti-bot site closes/swaps the page it just polled a dead/wrong-page session until finish, and there was no way to return to the requested --url after the login redirect. A (page-death recovery, capture_session.py): the per-tick path now reopens a page + re-navigates to start_url when the context has no live page, so the session survives an anti-bot close instead of going dead; pure decision logic (_recovery_decision/_live_pages) unit-tested, live reopen best-effort. B ("Go to my capture URL"): a GOTO sentinel (scoped like FINISH/CANCEL) + cockpit_core.goto_capture + POST /cockpit/api/captures/goto + an SPA button in CaptureWorkflow.tsx re-navigate the live page back to start_url after a login redirect dumps it on home. C (challenge settle, capture_session.py): _settle_through_challenge waits out a detected cloudflare/akamai interstitial (by title) before treating the page as content; default 20s, BD_CHALLENGE_WAIT_S=0 disables, zero-cost on a normal site (title check returns immediately when no challenge marker present). D (signed-JWPlayer auto-template, build_template_from_wacz.py): NEW R5 recognizer catches a signed progressive .mp4?token=... (no resolution-in-name/attachment/range/.ts -- missed by R1-R4 and by extraction_core's media regex) and JWPlayer playlist/media targets, emitting a SIGNING-FREE templated pattern (.../{signed}.mp4, query stripped -- no signed value persisted, F2) + signed-media/jwplayer signals so the draft is classified as signed-direct-media instead of a near-empty 1-pattern blank; a _jwplayer_player_markers helper adds JWPlayer container + play-button selectors so the runtime Pick->Test->Promote path has a handle. CAP-CANCEL (separate, guard-free): the onboarding capture launch (api_template_onboard, capture_required) is a detached subprocess with no cockpit task_id, so /cockpit/api/captures/finish (task_id-keyed) could not stop it; NEW POST /api/sites/<sid>/template_capture_cancel drops <wacz>.CANCEL from the persisted template_capture handle (no path values returned), and template_status now reports capture_in_flight so SiteTemplateCard shows a "Cancel capture" control. DECLARED GUARD CHANGE: tools/capture_session.py fff3e972...157b -> 707dcd2b...a97c (A+B+C); the other 6 guards byte-identical. RED-first: test_capture_robustness 12/12 (A/B/C decision logic), test_capture_goto_renav 4/4 (B route+SPA), test_jwplayer_template_robustness 10/10 (D), test_cap_cancel 7/7. Regression: nav-resilience+capture_ux+ASI 35 pass/1 known-skip; builder/recognizer/player/extraction-core/golden/normalizer 82/0; tsc -b + vite build clean. NEW routes -> ENDPOINT_CATALOG/gui_parity/G12/dependency_graph regenerated; FUNCTION_INDEX += api_template_capture_cancel (app.py). Live recovery/re-nav/challenge-wait + D against a real signed-JWPlayer WACZ are stash-only -- verify on the host. 3-part bump 292->293.

## v3.66.292 -- UI-DAL: fix the broken "Open DOM analyzer / workbench ->" SPA link (frontend-only; NO guard, NO route). FIELD BUG (operator-reported): clicking "Open DOM analyzer / workbench ->" on the /capture Review step did nothing -- the operator saw the URL become 10.0.70.20:5555/capture#/dom-analyzer and the page never navigated. Root cause: CaptureWorkflow.tsx rendered the control as `<a href="#/dom-analyzer">`, but the SPA is a PATH-based router (main.tsx: `<BrowserRouter basename="/">`), so a `#/...` href is only an in-page hash fragment -- it appends to the current path and triggers no navigation. The /dom-analyzer route itself is fine (App.tsx) and is reached correctly elsewhere via `<Link to="/dom-analyzer">` (Settings.tsx) and `go("/dom-analyzer")` (CommandPalette.tsx); only this one shortcut was a dead link. nav_reachability did NOT catch it because the route HAS inbound links -- this link was broken, not missing. FIX: replace the `<a href="#/dom-analyzer">` with a React-Router `<Link to="/dom-analyzer">` (the Settings.tsx / LogDiff.tsx pattern), className preserved, and add `import { Link } from "react-router-dom"` (the file imported nothing from react-router before). 2 edits to one .tsx. RED-first test_v3_66_292_dom_analyzer_link 3/3 as a CLASS gate, not a one-link assertion: on a path-based BrowserRouter ANY `href="#/..."` (a route path stuck behind a hash) is structurally dead, so the gate scans every frontend/src/**/*.tsx for it (exactly one existed -- the bug) and additionally pins the DOM-analyzer control to `<Link to="/dom-analyzer">` + the Link import; RED on pristine 291 (the dead href present, no Link), GREEN after the fix -- and the class gate prevents recurrence. Scope note: the gate targets only internal hash-PATH hrefs (`href="#/..."`); it deliberately ignores a bare `href="#"` placeholder or a real fragment anchor `href="#section"`. tsc -b clean; vite build clean. Regression band test_gui_parity 12/12 + test_v3_66_274_capture_ux 7/7 + test_v3_66_292 3/3 = 22/22, 0 fail. precut_check TOUCH_MAP: CaptureWorkflow row += test_v3_66_292_dom_analyzer_link. Guards 7/7 byte-identical (NO guard touched). NO route change -> ENDPOINT_CATALOG/gui_parity/G12/FUNCTION_INDEX/dependency_graph unchanged (precut predicted in-sync regens: none). 3-part bump 291->292.

## v3.66.291 -- ReDoS fix in the capture export-boundary redaction scrub (Tier-B; NO guard). FIELD BUG: an ultrafilms 8K capture (JWPlayer signed direct-media) finished but write_wacz never returned -- tools/capture_session.py hung at 100% CPU for 19+ minutes (State R, wchan=0/zero syscalls, single thread, flat 118 MB RSS -> a pure-CPU spin, NOT OOM and NOT a signal kill; the box had 508 GiB free, MemoryMax=infinity). Root-caused to catastrophic regex backtracking (ReDoS) in bulk_downloader/capture_artifact_redact.py: _KV_SECRET_RE embedded the secret-keyword alternation BETWEEN two greedy `[A-Za-z0-9_-]*` runs, so a long contiguous word-character DOM string (a JWPlayer framework class chain / concatenated id / base64 blob) with no trailing `=` made the engine try every split of the run at every offset -> exponential; _EMAIL_RE / _URL_USERINFO_RE / _BARE_USERINFO_RE were quadratic on the same shape (a greedy run then a required delimiter `@`/`:` that never arrives). redact_value + _value_findings apply these per string over the whole capture (redact_capture + scan_floor_secrets), so ONE such string pinned the WACZ export forever. FIX: put an UPPER BOUND on every greedy run (`{m,n}`, not `{m,}`) so a no-delimiter string can no longer drive O(n^2)/exponential backtracking, and restructure the kv-secret detector -- NEW _KV_PAIR_RE matches a single bounded `key=value` run (a leading boundary lookbehind stops per-offset re-attempts inside one long token) and secrecy is decided by a post-match keyword check (NEW _kv_key_is_secret), removing the embedded alternation entirely. The bounds (RFC local-part 64 / domain 255; key 128, value 4096; jwt segment 8192; userinfo 512/256) sit far above any real secret, so matching is byte-for-byte unchanged -- only the worst case is now linear. capture_artifact_redact.py is NOT a release guard; the 7 guard SHAs are byte-identical. RED-first test_v3_66_291_redaction_redos 5/5: redact_value + _value_findings + build_wacz_bytes are linear on 4 pathological strings under a 2s budget the old code blew past (RED on 290: 3 timing tests time out); real kv/jwt/email/userinfo secrets still redacted + flagged and structure (color=red) survives; a secret embedded inside a large string is still caught (no coverage regression -- the F2 floor is unchanged). Regression band: redaction/scrub/wacz/dom 135/135 + builder/analyzer/capture-cut adjacents 60/60, 0 fail. NO route/frontend change (one backend module) -> ENDPOINT_CATALOG/gui_parity/G12/FUNCTION_INDEX unchanged; dependency_graph re-checked. 3-part bump 290->291.

## v3.66.290 -- Capture login-fidelity + live-HUD-to-SPA bridge (4 logical changes, one cut; MOVES the capture_session guard for C3). Background: an operator audit found "the password block fills but not the username/email" across BOTH the teach-login path AND the /capture (noVNC HUD + SPA) path, plus the HUD and the SPA inspector "not communicating". Root-caused to FOUR distinct defects. (287, teach) classify_login detected the password by a bare presence check (type=="password") but the username by a NARROW positive type-whitelist (text/email/tel/"") + tag=="input" -- so a same-page username/email field rendered as search/number/url/etc. was silently dropped (empty user_field, empty username_value) while the password classified fine. Fixed by detecting the username by EXCLUSION (mirror the password posture): the last recorded input/textarea that is not the password, not a non-text control (checkbox/radio/submit/button/reset/image/file/hidden/range/color), and not flagged secret. NEW _NON_TEXT_INPUT_TYPES. (288, teach) the in-page recorder kept its harvest in page-global window state (__pwrec_*), which a full document navigation destroys -- so a two-step login (username -> Next/navigate -> password) lost the page-1 username entirely. RECORDER_JS now rehydrates from sessionStorage on (re)install and persists each event back; SECRET POSTURE: only STRUCTURE is written to storage (the raw value channels _input_value AND text are blanked in the stored copy via _pwrecRedact), so no typed credential ever hits sessionStorage; harvest_recordings clears the store after reading (capture done -> forget). Cross-ORIGIN two-step is not covered (sessionStorage is per-origin) -- noted. (289, /capture C1+C2) the SPA /capture login pickers were DISCONNECTED from the live login: do_login reads only config.user_field/pass_field/submit_btn (+ learned.login), while the pickers wrote a draft template login block ({email,password}) that nothing mapped to those keys -- so picked login selectors never drove login (it fell back to the 154-selector list). C1: relabel the single credential slot login.email -> "login.username / email" (it is the canonical username-OR-email slot per build_template_from_wacz) + add the missing login.submit picker (wired through assembleDraft + applyAiSelector). C2: NEW pure bulk_downloader/capture_login_wire.apply_draft_login_selectors(cfg, login_block) maps draft login.{email,password,submit} -> config {user_field,pass_field,submit_btn} with PRESERVE-IF-PRESENT (only fills empty/blank keys; never clobbers an operator-set or teach-learned selector), applied at the test_extract draft-override set so the OPV verification run logs in via the operator's PICKS. (290, /capture C3 -- GUARD MOVE) the live action timeline + verify readout (inspect_pick.correlate_timeline / verify_summary -- STRUCTURE-ONLY, no values) were rendered ONLY into the noVNC HUD via _inject_hud, never to the SPA. NEW LIVE-MIRROR sidecar in element_pick (inspect_state_path / write_inspect_state / read_inspect_state -- read does NOT delete; it is a continuously-refreshed mirror, unlike the one-shot PICK_RESULT/DOM_RESULT). tools/capture_session.py _pump_dom writes INSPECT_STATE.json each tick (best-effort; never disturbs capture) -- THIS is the guard change. cockpit_core.pick_capture gains an inspect_poll action (reuses /cockpit/api/captures/pick -> NO new route). The SPA polls it in the Inspect step and renders a "Live HUD analysis" panel (action timeline + readiness tier + warnings). GUARD DECLARATION: tools/capture_session.py 8802f2feee0607ff..097bf -> fff3e972173ab0b4..c157b (the inspect-state write in _pump_dom; structure-only, F2-consistent); the other 6 guards byte-identical. RED-first: test_v3_66_287 8/8, test_v3_66_288 6/6, test_v3_66_289 6/6, test_v3_66_290 7/7; regressions (classify/teach/recorder + pick-endpoint/dom-excerpt/console/capture-cockpit) 0-fail. Frontend tsc -b clean; node --check on RECORDER_JS clean. dependency_graph regen (+capture_login_wire node). NO route change across all four -> ENDPOINT_CATALOG/gui_parity/G12/FUNCTION_INDEX unchanged. Live browser/noVNC/login legs are not sandbox-runtime-testable (verified by compile + tsc + pure-logic unit tests). 3-part bump 286->290.

## v3.66.285 -- Cloak-parity audit/fix + BP-CFG global-config schema validation (Tier-B; NO guard). TWO things, one cut. (1) CLOAK PARITY: an audit of every browser launch found that the operator-facing TEST surfaces and several site-fetch paths launched RAW vanilla Playwright (`sync_playwright().chromium.launch()`) while real captures/downloads go through CloakBrowser (runner._launch_browser / cloak.*) -- so a fingerprinting site rendered/behaved DIFFERENTLY in the test than in production (the test could show zero/wrong selector matches, or get challenged, none reflecting a real cloaked capture). Fixed by routing all of them through the canonical backend. NEW cloak.cloaked_page(headless, user_agent, ...) context manager: the ephemeral counterpart to cloak.persistent_context -- yields a Page from CloakBrowser (else vanilla Playwright as fail-open), applies user_agent ONLY on the Playwright fallback (CloakBrowser supplies its own fingerprint), and owns full teardown (context -> browser -> pw.stop() on the fallback). Routed through it / cloak.launch_browser: app.api_template_sandbox mode=browser (the capture-workflow "Test (live)" selector probe), auto_detect (deep_detect render + detect_site_config live probe), runner._playlist_expand_one + _search_site, selector_playground._fetch_playwright, macro_replay.replay (login/nav macro). LEFT vanilla on purpose: healthcheck._check_playwright (reads chromium.executable_path only -- an install probe, never .launch()es, never navigates) and cloak.py itself (owns the abstraction + its Playwright fallback). NEW permanent SOURCE-AUDIT gate (test_v3_66_285_cloak_parity): scans bulk_downloader/*.py and fails if any module except cloak.py calls a raw chromium.launch( -- a new bypass can't land silently. (2) BP-CFG (#9): global_config.get() is a FLAT lookup, so a nested block in app_config.json ({"automation": {"auto_refresh": true}}) means get("auto_refresh") silently returns the default -- the feature is silently OFF (the 266 footgun); a typo'd flat key is the same. NEW validate_config(data, schema, known_nested) (pure) returns findings of kind nested_wont_resolve (a top-level dict, not in KNOWN_NESTED=tunnels/global_settings/automation_policy, whose sub-keys shadow flat schema keys), type_mismatch, and typo_near_miss (edit-distance<=1 of a schema key -- only typos fire, not every legit unknown key). GLOBAL_CONFIG_SCHEMA seeds the automation lifecycle flags (auto_refresh/repair/quarantine/promote) as safety-bearing with safe_default=False (fail-closed = manual, per AUTOMATION_POLICY). get_config() now validates on every fresh load: logs each finding LOUDLY to stderr naming the key + apply_fail_closed() resets safety flags with a bad type to their safe default -- but still LOADS (fail-open into use; advisory, never a hard refusal). precut TOUCH_MAP: global_config.py band + cloak_parity wired onto app/runner/cloak/auto_detect/macro_replay/selector_playground. RED-first test_v3_66_285_cloak_parity 5/5 + test_v3_66_285_config_validation 9/9; regressions cloak/macro/auto_detect/search 168/168, runner-surface + sandbox 49/49, config cache/snapshot/lifecycle 52/52. Stealth difference is observational (stash); the audit + helper logic are the sandbox gate. Guards 7/7 byte-identical. FUNCTION_INDEX regen (runner/app bodies). NO route change (api_template_sandbox body only) -> ENDPOINT_CATALOG/gui_parity/G12 unchanged. 3-part bump 284->285.

## v3.66.284 -- BP-INT download-integrity size gate (Tier-B product; NO guard). _http_download previously promoted the `.part` to its final name UNCONDITIONALLY after the chunk loop, so a transfer that ended short of the advertised Content-Length (mid-stream connection drop) produced a complete-looking file marked `done`; the existing Phase-17.20 size-sanity check only catches gross shortfalls (<5% of the page-advertised size) and marks `failed`, missing an 80%-truncated transfer. NEW: constants._DownloadTruncated (Exception; deliberately NOT a subclass of _HTTPDownloadFailed so the mirror-retry / Playwright-fallback handlers don't swallow it). Two pure staticmethod seams on SiteRunner mirroring the 282 pattern: _integrity_size_ok(downloaded,total) (fail-open when total<=0 -> chunked/no-length cannot be judged) and _promote_or_abort(tmp,final,downloaded,total,meta_path) (atomic os.replace on a full transfer; else remove the .part+meta WITHOUT touching any existing final, and raise _DownloadTruncated). Gate wired into _http_download before the rename: direct path through _promote_or_abort, ramdisk path gated explicitly (cross-device promote can't os.replace). Caller routes _DownloadTruncated -> needs_review (not failed, not the browser fallback) so the operator can force a re-download (BP-VH3). precut_check TOUCH_MAP: runner.py band now includes test_v3_66_284_integrity. RED-first test_v3_66_284_integrity 6/6 (decision, exception identity, atomic promote, unknown-length fail-open, truncated abort = no final + .part removed, abort-doesn't-clobber-existing-final). Runner-surface band 16/16; extraction_core+gcw 30/30. Atomic-rename + size-check sandbox-verified; real-network truncation is stash. Guards 7/7 byte-identical. 3-part bump; NO route/frontend change (backend + tooling only -> no vite rebuild).

## v3.66.276 -- Robust row selector (auto-scope) + auto-detect row groups (one consolidated cut). (1) AUTO-SCOPE: bdPickSelector now auto-scopes an inflated group_selector to the visible responsive container -- when group_count > group_visible (lg+md+mob duplicate wrappers), it walks up to the nearest stable ancestor whose scoped selector matches ONLY the visible rows and ALL of them, emitting e.g. `div.grid-view.view-lg a.tile` instead of the bare inflated `a.tile`. Adds group_raw_selector (always the unscoped signature, for the "matched N / visible M" surface) and group_scoped (true=scoped, false=inflated-but-no-clean-scope -> review, null=no inflation). (2) VISIBILITY-GATED CAP: find_best_download's learned fast-path now scores up to 30 VISIBLE rows (scanning up to 200 raw) instead of 30 raw iterations, so a back-loaded visible block behind a hidden duplicate block is no longer missed (was a silent fall-through to the wide sweep). (3) AUTO-DETECT (live): element_pick.bdAutoRowGroups ranks the dominant repeating, visible, download-shaped tile signature on the held-open page and returns scoped candidates; reached via the new AUTO_ROW_REQUEST/AUTO_ROW_RESULT sentinels serviced inside maybe_arm_and_collect (capture_session.py untouched -> guard byte-identical), cockpit_core.suggest_rows_capture, and the ROOT route POST /api/captures/suggest_rows (deploys via overlay, NOT the excluded /cockpit blueprint). SPA: a "Suggest rows" button + an auto-prefill of row_selectors on capture-step entry. Recommendation only -- operator-gated, never auto-promoted. (4) AUTO-DETECT (offline): build_template_from_wacz._generic_row_selectors_from_html mirrors the ranking offline (no visibility) as a setdefault fallback so a WACZ-built draft ships with auto-detected row_selectors when no modal/timeline rows exist. New route (in-sync regen: ENDPOINT_CATALOG/FUNCTION_INDEX/gui_parity/dependency_graph); guards 7/7 byte-identical. Live cross-process suggest path proves on stash; bridge logic + detector JS + offline derivation are sandbox-tested.

## v3.66.274 -- GCW probe mode + capture-UX cluster (one consolidated cut). (1) PROBE MODE (trigger -> media -> first-bytes -> abort): a "Quick probe" Test toggle samples the first bytes (<=256 KB) of the media URL after the trigger fires, then aborts -- proves the trigger->media->bytes path without downloading the whole file or needing a download_dir. Runner job-flag (probe) routes _process_one to _do_probe_fetch around the no-dl-dir branch; records the same /api/history verdict the GCW-4 gate reads. (2) WATCH ROBUSTNESS: watchForVerdict now also reads the live in-flight job from /api/status so a multi-GB Test doesn't time out before the download finishes (a 3.8 GB download completed but the old fixed ~2.5 min deadline expired first); waits while bytes flow up to a 45 min cap, surfaces progress, bails only on a real stall / cap / never-started. Ports the legacy static/approval_ui.js auto-submit / post-reveal approval gate into the React SPA. ROUTE ADDED, so the in-sync gates were regenerated: FUNCTION_INDEX 1093->1094, ENDPOINT_CATALOG 971->972, gui_parity_inventory 1095->1096; DEPENDENCY_GRAPH UNCHANGED (edges=760 -- learn's lazy `from . import deep_detect`, runner's `from .learn import record_pending_approvals`, and app's `from . import learn` all import modules already imported on those edges, so no new cross-module edge); G12 route-counts OK (the new route is a top-level app route, not a gated blueprint -- report_center/actions_center/section/blueprint counts unchanged). PLAN CORRECTION (re-derived from source, NOT the 261 plan): T11 was specced as "frontend-only, backend unchanged" on the premise that a per-site deep_detect report with pending candidates was already reachable by the SPA. It was NOT -- the candidates (login-form / page-blocker / post-reveal forms carrying bot-defense / CAPTCHA / challenge markers, approval_status="pending") are EPHEMERAL deep_detect output against page HTML; learned.deep_detect persisted only OUTCOMES + the operator's DECISIONS, never the candidates, and SiteEntryV2 carries only a coarse captcha_pending bool. So a strictly frontend-only port would have wired a gate with nothing to render. FIX (option A): persist-then-surface. (1) bulk_downloader/learn.py (NOT a guard) -- new pending_approvals sub-dict in _dd_init_block; record_pending_approvals(config, report) upserts the CURRENT pending auto-submit (key=approval_key) + post-reveal (key=_post_reveal_key(action)) candidates, storing marker LABELS only (kind/why) + a timestamp -- NO secret value (F2); bounded by _DD_MAX_PENDING=20 (oldest by `at` evicted). pending_approvals(config) returns the undecided list, SELF-CLEARING any entry whose key already has a recorded decision (auto_submit_decisions / post_reveal_decisions) so an approve/decline removes the row on the next read with NO fresh analysis. (2) bulk_downloader/runner.py (NOT a guard) -- one call to record_pending_approvals beside the existing record_deep_detect_outcome at the deep_detect fallback site (same report, once per run, fail-soft in the same try). (3) bulk_downloader/app.py -- NEW route GET /api/sites/<sid>/pending_approvals -> {ok, pending:[{surface,key,kind,why,at}], count}; 404 unknown site; read-only, marker labels only (F2 posture, same as vpn_secrets_status). (4) frontend: NEW hooks/useApproval.ts (useQuery on /api/sites/${sid}/pending_approvals + two useMutations approveAutoSubmit/decideReveal -- FULL /api/ literals so gui_parity flips all three spa_wired; invalidate on success); NEW components/ApprovalGate.tsx (renders ONLY when count>0 -- per-candidate surface/kind/why + Approve/Decline as a reversible single-tap toast-confirm per the v3.66.209 tier model, NOT a typed token, NOT zero-confirm); SiteDetail.tsx mounts <ApprovalGate> at the top of the site content; api-types.ts gains PendingApproval / PendingApprovalsResponse / ApprovalDecisionResult. The SAFETY interposition (do_not_auto_submit stays closed until an explicit approve; fail-open-into-review) is unchanged in the backend and pinned end-to-end. tsc --noEmit clean; vite build clean. RENDER-GATE PROVEN (make_server + Playwright): SiteDetail with a seeded pending cf-turnstile candidate renders the "Approval needed (1)" gate + Approve/Decline; the no-pending control renders no gate. ## v3.66.263 -- BUILD-HYG: exclude the root app_config.json from the release manifest (path-scoped) + empty the stale frontend/app_config.json path_allowlist. Guards 7/7 byte-identical (the fix is bulk_downloader/dev_suite.py, NOT a guard; tools/build_release.py untouched at 494aa319). ROOT CAUSE: any app boot in the source tree runs api_tokens._signing_secret(), which set_config()s a freshly-minted api_auth_token_secret into the cwd-relative app_config.json (global_config._CONFIG_FILE) -- so the LIVE signing secret leaked into the 262 full zip (scrubbed by hand that cut) and an unzip -o overlay would clobber the operator's real secret. Safe to drop from the manifest: the app re-seeds app_config.json on a fresh first run when absent (first_run = not APP_CFG_FILE.exists()), the deploy overlay already excludes it, and it is not on the v3.66.161 REQUIRED-PRESENT allowlist. Also emptied frontend/app_config.json path_allowlist -> [] (a dead, unreferenced shipped dev snapshot carrying the sandbox's seeded paths; cosmetic, zero runtime effect). The runtime first-run seed in app.py -- the v3.47.8 #80 DAST-audit hardening that computes per-operator BD_HOME + ~/Downloads/bulk_downloader -- is INTENTIONALLY left non-empty (empty path_allowlist is permissive: "accept any absolute non-traversing path"). ## v3.66.261 -- Recognizer follow-up #1: no-tell weak-markup -> native_custom (tools/player_recognition.py; NOT a guard -- guards 7/7 byte-identical). NO route/app/runner/frontend change; FUNCTION_INDEX / ENDPOINT_CATALOG / DEPENDENCY_GRAPH / G12 route-counts all in sync, NO regen (new module-level constants + one _markup_brand_has_tell helper using already-imported re; no new cross-module edge; player_recognition is not tracked by FUNCTION_INDEX). Generalizes the v3.66.260 DEFERRED one-family videojs demoter, which whack-a-moled -- demoting the top markup-only match just promoted the next stacked weak brand (jwplayer on newsensations, brid_tv on w3schools). New rule in detect(): when EVERY eligible candidate is a markup-class brand (videojs / jwplayer / brid_tv / plyr / flowplayer / clappr / mediaelement) resting ONLY on CSS-class markup -- none carrying a lib-script, an exclusive element/id/data-attr, or a storage tell -- AND the page is a fundamentally native <video> with OBSERVED progressive delivery (positive .mp4/progressive evidence; NOT a media-less `unknown`, NOT adaptive HLS/DASH, NOT MSE), all such matches demote together so the generic native_custom fallback wins (a leftover skin is not the active engine). Demoted families stay in candidates + a note; nothing fabricated. KEY refinement vs the prototype: the gate requires POSITIVE progressive delivery, not the mere ABSENCE of adaptive -- a media-less brand class (e.g. a membership gate that never loaded the player, delivery=`unknown`) KEEPS its brand. (That fixed a real regression the absence-only condition caused on the MemberPress wrapper fixture in test_player_recognition_packs_dei.) Fixes the newsensations videojs over-call: all 4 redacted captures now resolve native_custom (delivery=progressive, videojs 0.7 / jwplayer 0.4 still visible in candidates, no tell). NEW tests/test_recognizer_no_tell_markup_261.py (13: 6 new-behavior RED-on-pristine -> GREEN; 7 keep-tests green on both -- script / storage / data-attr tells + adaptive delivery + no-<video> + media-less-unknown all KEEP the brand; + a _markup_brand_has_tell unit). Pinned in the scorecard: tests/test_recognizer_scorecard.py +2 (a SYNTHETIC newsensations-shape entry -> native_custom, scored correct) so a future reintroduction of the over-call is a committed-test failure, not a manual corpus walk. Regression sweep: recognizer + families + generic + edge + pack_bc + packs_dei + scorecard + supplemental(197) + aylo(249) + reactplayer + storage(171) + phase4-jwplayer(18/20/23) + cockpit-display + ai2_ai7(260) = 322 passed / 0 failed / 2 skipped; builder-recognition + build_template + extraction + capture-model + workflow (25 files) = 207 passed / 0 failed. extraction_core + all 7 guards untouched (byte-identical). ## v3.66.259 -- capture_scrub.py hardening (F2 residual-audit follow-up; tools/capture_scrub.py is NOT a guard -- guards 7/7 byte-identical). NO route/app/runner/frontend change; FUNCTION_INDEX (1093) / ENDPOINT_CATALOG (971) / DEPENDENCY_GRAPH (edges=760) / G12 route-counts all in sync, NO regen (the new helpers are function-local + use already-imported re -> no cross-module import). ## v3.66.258 -- A6.2 passive-capture workflow-trigger derivation (builder-only; tools/build_template_from_wacz.py). Guards 7/7 byte-identical; NO route/app/runner/frontend change; FUNCTION_INDEX (1093) / ENDPOINT_CATALOG (971) / DEPENDENCY_GRAPH (edges=760) / G12 route-counts all in sync, NO regen needed (the two new helpers add no cross-module import). Two ADDITIVE, review-only, value-free increments to _derive_workflow_timeline, motivated by a corpus-breadth finding (the dom_log trigger path "never fired on real data" because rrweb rarely serializes a modal-open): (1) increment-1 effect-correlation fallback -- when no modal-open anchored a trigger AND no operator action_timeline exists, the click IMMEDIATELY preceding the first download-resolution/manifest response becomes the trigger candidate, mirroring the action_timeline path's "first click whose effect produced media" rule computed offline from click+response timestamps. CONSERVATIVE: fires ONLY when such a response exists AND a timestamped click precedes it -- never fabricates a trigger on a site with no download signal; never overwrites the stronger structural `trigger`; action_timeline still wins for captures that recorded operator picks. (2) increment-2a anchor resolution -- rrweb records the click on the deepest target (often a text/icon node that resolves to no selector); NEW _parent_index + _click_selector walk a non-element target UP to its nearest ancestor element, and the evidence string flags "resolved to nearest clickable ancestor" so a reviewer sees it is container/icon-level, not a labelled control. Net on the local capture corpus: +6 families (media, nubiles, reptyle, tiny, wow, wow247) gain a review-only trigger candidate via the dom_log path, 0 regressions. extraction_core + all 7 guards untouched. NEW: +4 tests in tests/test_workflow_derivation.py (positive fire, no-fabrication negative, value-free, text-target ancestor resolution).

stays b96f4af3). Two SPA fixes: (1) Command Palette items were unclickable + dimmed -- cmdk 1.0 sets
data-disabled="false" on ENABLED items and the shadcn wrapper's Tailwind class data-[disabled]: matched
attribute PRESENCE, applying pointer-events:none + opacity-50 to every item; clicks fell through to the
[cmdk-group-items] wrapper so onSelect never fired (keyboard Enter still worked). Fixed ui/command.tsx to
match the value (data-[disabled=true]:) -- the whole palette is clickable again (verified: click -> /capture).
(2) The /capture noVNC embed was min-h-[46vh]; the canvas column is already full-width (1fr) but
height-starved, so a large remote desktop scaled down to ~0.46x and the page/HUD were unreadable. Bumped
the embed to min-h-[78vh] (~0.79x for a 1920-wide remote). Full crispness still also depends on the
stash-side Xvfb resolution / noVNC scaling (BD_NOVNC_URL resize=, operator-set; LOOSE-8).

## v3.66.249

Builder now recognizes a generic download-API host that `extraction_core` misses (FIX A of the
247 sweep plan, replacing the bangbros gap). `extraction_core` only flags an `observed_api_host`
on the hardcoded reptyle shape `/api/v{n}/movie/{id}/download-resolution/{res}`; Aylo platforms
(bangbros/brazzers/realitykings), Gamma (evilangel/adulttime/dfxtra), vip4k, and the tubes
(xnxx/xvideos) serve downloads as `.../video-download/{id}` on a host distinct from the content
CDN, so the core saw no API host and `_download_api_template` bailed on >1 host. The new builder-side
`_merge_supplemental_api` mines `network_log` independently, identifies the single download-API host
specifically (multi-host safe; never guesses among several; media/asset URLs skipped), and surfaces a
review-only `api_template` candidate — never the runtime base, never enabled. Also a username login
fallback (FIX B): `_html_selectors` now fills the credential slot from a `username`/`login` id or name
when no email-ish field is present (e.g. bangbros `#username`), anchored so a `*-password` id is never
grabbed. Non-guard (`build_template_from_wacz.py`); `extraction_core` and the 7 release guards stay
byte-identical. Verified: unit 7/7 (incl. real bang247 + wow247 strict captures) + 246 modal sweep
12/12 unchanged + 248 FIX-3 intact + corpus 70/70 build_template additions-only / 0-crash
(18 api_template + 17 login.email additions, `row_selectors`/`trigger` byte-identical).

## v3.66.248

Builder now derives `row_selectors` for inline direct-download-link sites from the operator
action_timeline (FIX 3 of the 247 sweep plan). Supersedes FIX 2 (modal-scope token broadening),
which the live B2 wowgirls capture disproved — wowgirls serves downloads as inline direct media
links with no modal at all, so there was no modal scope to broaden. Non-guard
(`build_template_from_wacz.py`); `extraction_core` and the 7 release guards stay byte-identical.

- Builder (`_download_trigger_from_timeline` placement): when a recorded download click produced
  direct media and its element is an `<a>` AND no modal-scoped rows were derived, the generalized
  anchor family selector (e.g. `a.ct_dl_button[data-framerate]`) is now filed under
  `download.row_selectors` instead of `download.trigger`. Previously such an inline direct-link
  anchor was misclassified as a modal-open `trigger`, so the seed shipped with a download link as
  its "opener" and ZERO rows, forcing manual review to hand-wire the rows. A `<button>` opener — and
  an `<a>` on a modal site whose modal-scoped rows are already present — are unchanged; the latter
  still seeds `trigger`, preserving the v3.66.246 generic-`a[download]` anti-collapse. The real
  wowgirls capture now auto-derives `row_selectors: ['a.ct_dl_button[data-framerate]']` with no
  trigger; the FIX 1 (v3.66.247) visibility gate then selects the visible fps set at runtime.
- Verified: new RED→GREEN unit test; the real scrubbed wowgirls strict capture; the full v3.66.246
  modal sweep (12/12, no test change required); the builder suite (249 passed, 1 pre-existing
  data:URL skip); and the 63-WACZ corpus (63/63 byte-identical derivations, 0 crashes — a pure
  addition that activates only on the new inline direct-link archetype).

## v3.66.247

`find_best_download` learned fast-path no longer returns non-visible matches. A non-guard,
B2-independent hardening cut (FIX 1 of the 247 sweep plan); the builder modal-scope token
broadening (FIX 2) is held for the live B2 verify.

- Detection (learned fast-path): a learned `row_selector` that matches DOM elements which are
  not `is_visible()` — canonically a modal-scoped discriminating row while the modal is closed —
  is no longer scored or returned as a `_via_learned` hit. Previously such a hidden row was
  returned, producing a false drift "hit", a wasted `expect_download` timeout on an unclickable
  element, and a misdiagnosable "matched but never downloads" outcome. The selector now falls
  through to a clean no-learned-hit + wide sweep. A raising `is_visible()` is treated as a skip
  (fail-closed), consistent with the existing per-element error handling on that path. Visible-row
  resolution (modal open) is unchanged — verified at unit, full-suite, and live-browser
  (cloakbrowser) levels.

## v3.66.245

Two bugfixes from a B2-unblock + adversarial capture sweep this session (both non-guard).

Fix 1 (app.py) -- the B2 live-extract surface (POST /api/template/test_extract) crashed at
enqueue with "'SiteRunner' object has no attribute 'add_url'" whenever a URL was supplied.
SiteRunner has no add_url/add_urls; the real enqueue method is load_urls([...]) -- the same
fix the v3.66.8 audit applied at the crash-recovery orphan-resume path. This recreated that
bug in two new spots: the test_extract enqueue (visible 500) and a silent twin in
/api/discovery/run (RSS/sitemap enqueue, swallowed by except: pass -- it had been enqueuing
nothing). Both now call load_urls([url]). Same-line swaps: app.py line count unchanged, so
FUNCTION_INDEX stays in sync; no route/import change. RED-first regression:
tests/test_v3_66_245_test_extract_enqueue.py (the enqueue POST returned the 500 on pristine
244; green after the swap; a second case pins the no-url override-only branch enqueues nothing).

Fix 2 (capture_artifact_redact.py -- the F2 floor) -- a DEFAULT-posture capture (relaxed
redaction OFF) could still raise WaczRedactionError: "signed_url would survive into
capture.json". Root cause: redact_capture's _floor_walk ran on every non-dom field with
redact_signed_query=False (rationale: network_log is query-redacted at capture time), but
scan_floor_secrets flags signed_url in ANY non-dom field and, in default posture, never
forgives it. A signed URL in a field NOT scrubbed at capture time (action_timeline effect
URLs, route/media summaries, metadata) therefore survived the scrub yet tripped the floor;
worse, the kv pass scrubs token=/Signature= but leaves a non-secret signing param like
Expires that the detector still treats as sensitive, so only the full signed-query pass
clears it. Fix: _floor_walk now runs the signed-query pass when the network surface is NOT
keep_full (default/strip) and skips it under keep_full (preserving the intended residual,
exactly as scan_floor_secrets forgives it). The change only ever strips MORE in default
(never less) and is unchanged under keep_full; hard credentials (jwt/userinfo/opaque_token)
remain never-forgiven. RED-first regression: tests/test_v3_66_245_floor_signed_url_nondom.py
(default-posture signed_url survived + floor flagged on pristine 244; green after; keep_full
preserves Expires; hard creds always stripped). Full floor regression suite (242 + 166 + 171
+ secret_display_never) stays green; capture-model golden unchanged (the redactor is not in
the reader characterization).

Adversarial sweep also stress-ran the builder (0 crashes / 52 redacted WACZ) and the
normalizer (0 crashes / 26 drafts); the WowGirls download-selector adequacy (builder emits
the generic a[download]) is verify-after-deploy. Guards 7/7 byte-identical (both edited files
are non-guard).

## v3.66.244

Bugfix (non-guard, capture_artifact_redact.py -- the F2 floor): even with the
v3.66.243 both-surfaces relaxed-redaction toggle, a capture could STILL hit the
WaczRedactionError floor (observed: signed_url, 3 sites, both knobs keep_full). Root
cause: scan_floor_secrets' signed_url/kv_secret DETECTOR fires on a query carried by a
URL OR a root-relative path (startswith '/'), and on signed URLs whose '://' sits past
char 12 -- but the keep_full FORGIVENESS was gated on the stricter _url_like
(scheme-leading, or '://' in the first 12 chars). So a root-relative signed URL like
'/media/x?token=...' was detected yet NEVER forgiven, even under keep_full -- the skip
and the detector used different URL tests. Fix: the keep_full skip now forgives
signed_url/kv_secret for the SAME shape the detector uses (URL-or-root-relative with a
query). Bounded + safe: hard credentials (jwt/userinfo/opaque_token -- not in the skip
set) and raw, non-URL kv secrets (cookies/bodies with no query shape) remain NEVER
forgiven; the broadened forgiveness applies only on a keep_full surface (which already
self-stamps local_only). The floor still fails-closed without keep_full. RED-first: a
root-relative signed URL is forgiven under keep_full, still refused without it, and a
raw cookie kv_secret stays refused even under keep_full. Redactor OUTPUT unchanged
(this is a scanner-forgiveness fix, not a scrub change); capture-model golden unchanged.

## v3.66.243

Bugfix (non-guard, cockpit_core.py): the v3.66.242 relaxed-redaction toggle only
relaxed the NETWORK signed-URL surface, so a capture whose surviving signed URL was
on the DOM surface (e.g. an <img>/poster ?expires=... thumbnail) STILL hit the
WaczRedactionError floor even with the box checked -- confirmed on stash (env had
BD_REDACT_NETWORK_URLS=keep_full but not BD_REDACT_DOM_URLS). The floor gates the two
URL surfaces by separate knobs (network_signed_urls vs dom_embedded_urls); relaxing
only network left a DOM-surface signed URL refused. Fix: the toggle's env injection in
cockpit_core.start_task now sets BOTH BD_REDACT_NETWORK_URLS=keep_full AND
BD_REDACT_DOM_URLS=keep_full, so relaxed redaction relaxes both surfaces. The capture
still self-stamps reduced_redaction/local_only (either keep_full trips it); the floor is
unchanged for normal captures. RED-first: a floor test pins that a DOM-surface signed URL
is allowed only when the DOM knob is keep_full, and the env test now asserts both knobs.
Note: redact_capture's DOM scrub-completeness for shapes it misses remains the separate
Phase-C concern (export-boundary re-scrub).

## v3.66.241 -- Track F Wave B (Cut B2, GUI + restart-persistence fix): finishes Cut B2 by wiring the operator-facing affordances for the real-extraction draft-override, and fixes a Decision-4 contract break found while wiring it. **GUI (`tools/cockpit_console.py`, non-guard, DEPLOY-EXCLUDED / merge-not-overlay):** the Template Review Workbench stepper now AUGMENTS (does not repoint) the match-only "Test (live)" sandbox probe with a distinct, clearly-labelled "Test (live extract) -- REAL download off this UNREVIEWED draft" surface that calls the existing main-app `POST /api/template/test_extract` (a FULL literal via `apiRoot`, self-seeding `X-CSRF-Token` from `/api/csrf`). It carries: (a) a site picker populated from `/api/sites_list` (a draft candidate's host is not a site_id -- `s_cfg` is keyed by a generated sid -- so the operator explicitly picks which configured site to point the per-site override at; this is Decision 4 made explicit); (b) a default-OFF persist toggle threaded to the route's `persist` field; (c) an ENABLE box wired to the EXISTING `POST /api/template_manager/promote` (enable=true, optional accept_api) -- frontend-only, NO new route, runs the canonical `promote_draft` (blocking-lint refuse / A6-1 api-gate / pattern-hygiene / A5 backup-before-overwrite); (d) a standing "running off draft override" indicator + an explicit "Stop testing (clear)" control, both driven by the `_build_meta` booleans `draft_test_override_active` / `_persist` read off `/api/status`. The `/api/review-candidates` feed now forwards a NESTED, structural-only `override_template` (the override branch reads `selectors.download`/`.quality` + `resolutions` + `host` via `template_to_learned_download`; the FLAT `sandbox_template` the B1 buttons use would resolve ZERO selectors there -- a silent no-op download) plus the originating `draft_file` when it exists on disk. Same scrub posture as `sandbox_template`: selector SHAPES under known keys, never `**c`, no values. Render-confirmed via the make_server + Playwright recipe (all four affordances render with live data; the standing indicator showed an active seeded override). **Backend fix (`bulk_downloader/app.py`, non-guard):** the per-site `draft_test_override` did NOT actually survive a restart -- `_save_sites_config` writes it to disk, but `_load_sites_config` rebuilds each cfg from `CFG_FIELDS`, which deliberately omits the (transient runtime) override key, so a real process restart SILENTLY DROPPED it, breaking Decision 4 ("persists per-site, across sessions"). The shipped #4 test missed this because it asserted only that the key was on disk, never re-invoking `_load_sites_config`. Fix: a surgical load-side passthrough that carries the override back through the rebuild when present + well-formed (forwarded only when present, so sites that never used it stay clean); failure direction without the fix was fail-safe (a restart reverts to the enabled-only matcher) but it violated the stated contract. The #4 test (`test_override_survives_simulated_restart`) is strengthened to a true save -> `_load_sites_config` -> reread round trip (RED 14/15 pre-fix, GREEN 15/15 post-fix). **Guards:** all 7 byte-identical (build_release baseline 494aa319); `extraction_core.py` untouched. **Regen surface: NONE** -- the GUI adds no route (test_extract + promote both pre-exist), the app.py fix adds no function and no import edge, so ENDPOINT_CATALOG / FUNCTION_INDEX / gui_parity / G12 / DEPENDENCY_GRAPH all UNCHANGED; capture-model golden UNCHANGED. 3-part bump 240->241. Parity floor 1. **Verification (in-sandbox):** test_wave_b2_test_extract.py 15/15 (incl. the strengthened restart round-trip), plus the live render-confirm of the cockpit surface; banded from the extracted zip with test_wave_b1_panel_ui + test_contracts + the static-analysis/emoji gate; verify_release --zip PASS. **Binding gate stays STASH-ONLY and DEFERRED per operator** until B2 is deployed: the real WowGirls jwplayer download + the four invariants live + the full on-stash suite. **Deploy note:** this cut touches `cockpit_console.py` (merge-not-overlay -- reconcile against live cockpit edits) AND `app.py` (normal overlay); no `templates/` -- a full `unzip -o` must still exclude `templates/`.

## v3.66.240 -- Track F Wave B (Cut B2, BACKEND): real-extraction "Test (live)" draft-override -- the first path that lets an UNREVIEWED draft drive a real download through `_process_one`. **Context:** B1 (237) made the review-candidate lifecycle GUI-reachable, but its "Test (static/live)" was selector-MATCH only (`/api/template/sandbox`) -- it never downloaded. The runtime matcher (`template_registry.find_template_for_url`) loads `status=="enabled"` templates ONLY, so a draft can never reach the extractor through the normal path. B2 adds a per-site OVERRIDE that feeds a draft to the single template hook as a SEPARATE branch, never a relaxation of the enabled-only gate. **New route (the only one):** `POST /api/template/test_extract` (main-app, `_check_csrf`, http(s)-only url refusal) sets `config["draft_test_override"] = {template, draft_file, persist, set_at}` on the target site and triggers one real run; a `clear:true` body removes it. **Hook (`template_assist.py`):** `merge_template_download_hints` gains `override_template=None` -- when set, the draft is used directly; when None the enabled-only matcher branch is byte-identical to pre-B2. **Override plumbing (`runner.py`, 3 helpers):** `_draft_override_template` (reads the per-site override), `_override_suppresses_persist` (the single run-scoped no-persist guard), `_persist_learned_to_draft` (persist-ON writeback onto the draft's `learned` key, authored selectors intact). **Four locked invariants (re-derived from source; two corrected vs the older handoff note):** (1) ENABLE IS EXPLICIT-ONLY -- test_extract enables nothing and never writes `reviewed`/`enabled`; the only enable path is the EXISTING `POST /api/template_manager/promote` (-> `promote_draft`, unchanged: blocking-lint refuse / A6-1 api-gate / pattern-hygiene / A5 keystone). (2) PERSIST-BYPASS IS OPT-IN, default OFF -- CORRECTED: the learned-selector persist surface is FOUR chokepoints in runner.py (login takeover, download takeover, teach-commit add+save, drift-recovery prune+save), not two; all four are gated by `_override_suppresses_persist()`, so an OFF override run persists nothing (live config AND draft both untouched); ON persists to both. (3) CHALLENGE -> MANUAL HANDOFF -- CORRECTED to PARITY: the literal "never auto-solves" is not true of the code (`_handle_captcha_check` calls the pre-existing `_try_captcha_solve` before the manual handoff), but that solver is DEFAULT-OFF (no-op without an operator-set `captcha_api_key`) and B2 adds ZERO uplift -- the override path inherits the identical branch, so in the default (and in-sandbox no-key) posture a challenge falls through to the manual `needs_review` handoff, fail-open. B2 adds no auto-solve and no bypass; the captcha plumbing is byte-identical. (4) OVERRIDE IS PER-SITE + CLEARABLE -- keyed per-site, rides `_save_sites_config` (survives restart), exposes a compact standing indicator in `_build_meta` (`draft_test_override_active` / `_persist`, bulky dict stripped, no secret), removed by an explicit clear. **Guards:** all 7 byte-identical (build_release baseline 494aa319); `extraction_core.py` untouched. **Regen surface:** ENDPOINT_CATALOG / FUNCTION_INDEX (new route + 3 runner helpers) / gui_parity (new `/api/template/test_extract`) / DEPENDENCY_GRAPH (one new edge runner -> template_manager, edge_count 750->751, from `_persist_learned_to_draft`'s function-local import) regenerated. G12 NOT tripped (it gates the data_layer/report_center/actions_center blueprints only; this is a main-app route -- the handoff's "166->167 + G12 pin" was over-stated). 3-part bump 239->240. Parity floor 1 (the route is NET-NEW, not a legacy-tranche move). **Verification (in-sandbox):** test_wave_b2_test_extract.py 15/15 (Group A: override branch / no-override-unchanged / the 3 helpers / the 4-chokepoint guard assertion + hook wiring / captcha fail-open parity; Group B: route set/clear/persist-toggle/per-site-isolation/restart-survival/never-enables/input-validation), plus runner_template_assist + template_assist + template_registry + wave_b1 panel (20/20) and test_contracts (17/17) regression-clean, all from the extracted zip; verify_release --zip PASS. **GUI is NOT in this cut:** the cockpit "Test (live)" button + persist toggle + enable->promote wiring land in `tools/cockpit_console.py` (DEPLOY-EXCLUDED / merge-not-overlay, not click-testable in-sandbox) and are handed off separately. **Binding gate is STASH-ONLY:** the sandbox has no network, so the real download is verified on stash against the WowGirls jwplayer draft (set the override, run one extraction, confirm a real file downloads and the four invariants hold live), plus the full on-stash suite post-deploy.

## v3.66.239 -- Track F Wave A follow-up: the capture HUD's top readiness badge now agrees with the finish-bar for direct-download sites. **Context:** the v3.66.238 render-confirm on stash (WowGirls capture through CloakBrowser) showed the HUD top badge reading **PARTIAL** ("no manifest/segment ladder yet") on a capture that had in fact succeeded -- the finish-bar correctly read READY, "download captured", with the trigger line green on `a.ct_dl_button[data-framerate="60fps"]` (a signed direct-media MP4). The two verdicts disagreed because they used different definitions of "ready": `verify_summary` (the finish-bar) credits `has_direct`, but `readiness_panel` (the top badge) was **ladder-only** -- it counted only an HLS/DASH manifest or media segments, never a direct download. WowGirls is a JWPlayer/direct-download site that serves the video as a signed progressive MP4 (`media N (0 seg)` -- no segment ladder), so the badge mislabelled a complete capture as PARTIAL and the note implied a ladder was still coming when none ever would be. **Fix (non-guard, `dom_overlay.py`):** `readiness_panel` now treats a direct-media download as a path to READY -- `(has_manifest or has_segments or has_direct) and dom badge ok/unknown -> ready` -- mirroring `verify_summary`'s `has_direct` so the top badge and the finish-bar agree. The ready note lists which of manifest / segments / direct media was captured; the PARTIAL note is reworded to "no manifest/segment/direct-media yet". DRM-only media still reads BLOCKED (the drm_only branch is checked first and is unchanged), and a challenge/interstitial still reads BLOCKED -- a stray direct file does not override those. **No guard touched** (`dom_overlay.py` is not in the 7-guard set; all 7 byte-identical, build_release baseline 494aa319). **No route / no frontend / no app.py-runner.py** -> ENDPOINT_CATALOG / FUNCTION_INDEX / gui_parity / G12 / DEPENDENCY_GRAPH UNCHANGED; capture-model golden UNCHANGED (it snapshots the capture-model projection, not the HUD readiness verdict). 3-part bump 238->239. ## v3.66.236 -- Track F Wave A follow-up: HUD is collapsible, the verify bar stops crying wolf, and the inspector now resolves clicks AFTER a cross-origin navigation (the real "did pressing play capture anything?" fix). **Context:** the v3.66.235 render-confirm on stash (WowGirls capture through CloakBrowser) surfaced three operator-visible problems on the venus.wowgirls.com film page: the pinned HUD **covered page content and wouldn't collapse**; the "Ready to finish?" advisories **never went green** (the email/password field focuses each showed `fired 0 network`); and pressing PLAY **gave no feedback** that anything was captured. A redacted capture of that session (`w212wow`, scrubbed `--mode strict`, F2 local-only, never in-tree) pinned the cause: `action_timeline` carried ONLY the 4 login clicks (3 input focuses + the submit `req=62 -> nav`), all on `auth.wowgirls.com`; rrweb recorded 811 incrementals (all `frame_path=['main']`) including the venus browsing + play, but **zero** post-navigation venus clicks resolved -- the picker worked on `auth`, then went dark for the whole `venus` session. **Root cause (#2b):** the picker hands clicks back through a Playwright `expose_binding('__bd_inspect_pick')` that does **not** survive the cross-origin top-level document swap (`auth` -> `venus`); the in-page listener re-installs each pump tick, but its `typeof window.__bd_inspect_pick !== 'function'` guard then silently returns on every venus click. **#1 collapsible HUD (non-guard, `dom_overlay.py`):** the HUD title is now clickable (chevron ▾/▸) and collapses to a compact `host · TIER` pill via `window.__bd_hud_collapsed`, so it no longer permanently obscures the page. **#2a verify honesty (non-guard, `inspect_pick.py` + `dom_overlay.py`):** `verify_summary` no longer warns or counts gap on 0-network clicks whose `tag` is a form FIELD (`input`/`textarea`/`select`) -- focusing a field legitimately fires no network, so those advisories could never clear; and a new `trigger_resolved` bool drives an explicit trigger line in the verify section -- green `<selector> -> media captured` when the play/download click resolves, amber `no media trigger resolved yet -- click the player` when it does not, so the operator always knows whether play registered. **#2b cross-origin pick transport (GUARD, `tools/capture_session.py`):** the picker now stamps each click `{d:<descriptor>, ts:Date.now()}` and stays **binding-first** (live + nav-safe for the login-submit/download clicks that already resolved) but **buffers the identical record in-page** (`window.__bd_picks`) when the binding is absent; `_pump_dom` registers the listener via `page.add_init_script` (re-installs at document-start on EVERY navigation, cross-origin included) and **drains `window.__bd_picks` each tick** into the SAME `_record_pick`/`_normalize_pick` path as the binding -- so resolution (`inspect_pick`) and sink-side redaction (`redact_excerpt`) are identical regardless of transport. `ts` is the in-page epoch-ms stamp (JS `Date.now()` vs `int(time.time()*1000)`), so a drained pick still correlates inside the 2.5s window; a malformed record or legacy bare descriptor is handled defensively (drop / local-clock fallback). **Redaction seam, correlation, nav logic, and WACZ write are UNTOUCHED -- only the pick transport changed.** **GUARD declaration:** `tools/capture_session.py` c5729e71 -> **76a26b8f** (intentional, #2b); the other 6 guards byte-identical (build_release baseline 494aa319). **No route / no frontend / no app.py-runner.py** -> ENDPOINT_CATALOG / FUNCTION_INDEX / gui_parity / G12 / DEPENDENCY_GRAPH / capture-model golden UNCHANGED (the golden's three projected readers do not include the live pick transport). 3-part bump 235->236. Parity floor 1. **Verification:** test_capture_session_nav_resilience.py (4 `_normalize_pick` contract tests -- in-page ts preserved, float coercion + missing-ts fallback, legacy bare descriptor, malformed/non-dict dropped -- plus a new `test_pump_dom_wires_add_init_script_and_buffer_drain` positive control so the drain + `add_init_script` wiring cannot be silently removed), test_inspect_pick.py (+field-focus suppression with a button positive control, +`trigger_resolved`), test_dom_overlay.py (+trigger line resolved/unresolved, +collapse toggle, +picker buffers-when-binding-absent-else-uses-binding), test_wave_b_action_timeline_miner.py (5) + test_capture_model_golden.py (4) regression-clean -- 75/75 from the extracted zip. Deploys via normal overlay (capture_session is NOT deploy-excluded). **The real test is stash-only:** re-capture a cross-origin site and confirm the venus play click now resolves into the timeline and the trigger line goes green.

## v3.66.231 -- Track F Wave A: observational element inspector + action->effect record timeline + finish-time verify bar. **What:** during an interactive capture, the operator can now SEE what each of their own clicks did and get a finish-time confidence readout, without the tool ever driving the page. Three parts, all observational. **(a) Element inspector (`bulk_downloader/inspect_pick.py`, NEW, pure):** resolves a clicked element into a STABLE selector (`build_selector`: a stable `#id` -> `tag.stable-classes` optionally qualified by one short `[data-*]` enum -> ancestor-contextualised `:nth-child`; rejects uuid/framework ids via `_UNSTABLE_ID` and hashed/CSS-in-JS classes -- `css-1a2b3c`, `sc-bdVaJa`, emotion/styled -- via `_HASHED_CLASS`), an XPath (`build_xpath`), and an advisory role (`role_of`: download/play/quality/login/media heuristics). `redact_excerpt` keeps STRUCTURE (tag, class names, attribute KEYS, text) and scrubs value-bearing attribute VALUES (`href`/`src`/`data-*`/`value` -> `redact_query`/`PLACEHOLDER`, deny-by-default), so a logged-in element's signed `href` never becomes a stored pattern. **(b) Action recorder:** `bulk_downloader/dom_overlay.py picker_script()` installs a `{capture:true, passive:true}` click listener that hands each clicked element's DESCRIPTOR back through a Playwright `expose_binding("__bd_inspect_pick", ...)`; it NEVER calls `preventDefault`/`stopPropagation`, so the operator's own click still drives the site. `inspect_pick.correlate_timeline` then attributes each network request to its MOST-RECENT preceding click within a 2.5s window (not to every click whose window overlaps it -- so a request is counted once, against the click that plausibly caused it), and reports the effect as request KINDS + COUNTS via the shipped classifier (never URLs). **(c) Finish-time verify bar:** `inspect_pick.verify_summary` is an ADVISORY readout (never blocks finishing -- fail-open-into-review): overall readiness tier from the capture's own media, per-phase checks (auth/play/download), a list of clicks that fired 0 network (a likely missed or already-satisfied action), the resolved trigger selector (first click whose effect produced manifest/segment/direct-media), and a (B) rrweb cross-check that warns when rrweb saw more clicks than were resolved.
