## v3.49.0 — 2026-05-15

Phase 2 of the v3.48+ roadmap: queue UX. Bulk operations, drag-reorder,
priority chips, grouping, search, snapshots, templates. All the things
that make managing a 10K-row queue not feel like punishment.

**Runner additions** (`bulk_downloader/runner.py`)

- **`bulk_pause(urls)`** — pause pending jobs without removing them.
  Pending → stopped + "Paused by user" marker message. Running jobs
  continue (no killing of in-flight downloads).
- **`bulk_resume(urls)`** — inverse: stopped → pending.
- **`bulk_retry(urls)`** — re-queue failed/needs_review jobs with
  retries counter reset.
- **`bulk_reorder(ordered_urls)`** — rewrite the queue's order to match
  the supplied sequence. URLs not in the sequence keep their relative
  order at the end. Used by drag-to-reorder.
- **Crash-recovery flag (#127b)** — on boot, jobs that were in `running`
  state at shutdown are flagged `_recovered_from_crash`. The frontend
  surfaces this as a small badge so the operator knows which rows may
  have partial files / partial DB state.

**New endpoints** (`bulk_downloader/app.py`)

| Path | Method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/sites/<sid>/bulk_pause` | POST | Bulk pause |
| `/api/sites/<sid>/bulk_resume` | POST | Bulk resume |
| `/api/sites/<sid>/bulk_retry` | POST | Bulk retry failed |
| `/api/sites/<sid>/bulk_reorder` | POST | Drag-reorder support |
| `/api/sites/<sid>/queue/search` | GET | Server-side queue search (cursor-paginated) |
| `/api/sites/<sid>/queue/counts` | GET | Aggregate by-status counts |
| `/api/sites/<sid>/queue/grouped` | GET | Bucket queue by host/path/status/priority |
| `/api/sites/<sid>/queue/export` | GET | Dump live queue to JSON snapshot |
| `/api/sites/<sid>/queue/import` | POST | Import snapshot (append/replace mode) |
| `/api/sites/<sid>/queue/save_template` | POST | Save current queue as named template |
| `/api/queue_templates` | GET/POST | List / create templates |
| `/api/queue_templates/<id>` | GET/PUT/DELETE | Manage one template |
| `/api/queue_templates/<id>/apply/<sid>` | POST | Import a template into a site |

**New module: `bulk_downloader/queue_templates.py`**

Saved named queue snapshots. `queue_templates` SQLite table with URLs,
priority map, force_download set, use_count, ts_used. Templates are
site-agnostic — a template saved from Site A can be imported into Site
B (cross-site reuse).

**New module: `bulk_downloader/static/queue_ux.js` (~500 LOC)**

Frontend layer for everything above. Bulk-select toolbar (sticky,
slides in on first selection), checkbox-per-row with shift-click range,
native HTML5 drag-to-reorder with visual drop-line, priority chip
cycling, debounced server-side search input with hide/show on rows,
toolbar action handlers that hit the new bulk endpoints. Re-themeable
via `app.css` design tokens.

**Database additions** (`bulk_downloader/db.py`)

- **`queue_search(site_id, query, status, priority, after_ord, limit)`**
  — server-side queue filtering with cursor pagination. Same `id < ?`
  pattern as `db_search_cursor`, but on the `queue.ord` column.
- **`queue_count_by_status(site_id)`** — aggregate counts, cheaper than
  `/api/status` when only the summary chips need updating.
- **`queue_group_by(site_id, group_by, limit)`** — bucket queue rows by
  host / path / status / priority for the collapsible group view.
  Server-side grouping because regex-on-every-URL belongs on the server
  side, not in the browser main thread.

**Bonus fix**

Pre-existing collision between two `/api/library/orphans` handlers
(POST `api_library_orphans` and GET `api_library_orphans_v2`) only
tripped on module re-import. Renamed POST handler to
`api_library_orphans_post` for endpoint-name uniqueness.

**Test deltas**

- 3035 pass / 3 skip / 0 fail (+20 from v3.48.0 — pre-existing tests
  that started running once collisions cleared).

## v3.49.0 — 2026-05-15

Phase 2: queue UX. The Queue tab graduates from "scroll + click each
row" to a proper selection workflow: checkboxes with shift-click range
selection, a floating action bar at the bottom for bulk operations, and
a drag-to-reorder mechanism that works inside any one site's queue.
Plus a dedicated job-detail side drawer that shows everything the
runner knows about a single URL, and global pause/resume buttons.

**Bulk queue operations (single-API for N URLs each)**

- **#55 — Bulk mark / delete / priority.** Four new endpoints, all
  taking `{urls: [...], <op-specific>}`:
  - `POST /api/sites/<sid>/jobs/bulk_mark` — `{status, message?}`
    on N URLs. Status must be one of `pending`, `failed`,
    `needs_review`, `done` (same allowlist as the single-URL endpoint).
  - `POST /api/sites/<sid>/jobs/bulk_delete` — drop N URLs from the
    queue. Optional `force_cleanup=true` also removes `.bdseg.json` +
    `.part` sidecars for partial downloads.
  - `POST /api/sites/<sid>/jobs/bulk_priority` — set the `priority`
    label on N URLs. Truncated to 20 chars defensively.
  - All endpoints validate the URL list (1–5000 items, no empties),
    update in-memory runner state under the runner lock, persist to
    SQLite via the new `queue_bulk_*` helpers (chunked at 500/batch
    to stay under SQLite's 999-parameter limit), publish an SSE
    `queue_change` event, and return `{ok, affected, requested}`.
- **#56 — Drag-to-reorder.** `POST /api/sites/<sid>/jobs/reorder` takes
  `{ordering: {url: ord_int, ...}}` and updates the `ord` column for
  every URL in one transaction. Frontend ships HTML5-drag wiring on
  any `.qrow[data-draggable="1"]`: dragstart highlights the row;
  dragover shows a coloured insertion line above or below the target;
  drop reflows the DOM AND fires the API call. Cross-site drops are
  refused (server endpoint is site-scoped).
- **#71 — Global pause/resume.** `POST /api/runners/pause_all` and
  `/api/runners/resume_all` iterate every active runner. Pausing
  stops dequeueing but lets in-flight jobs complete (downloads aren't
  killed mid-stream). Each call returns `{ok, paused/resumed, failures}`
  so the UI can render per-site error feedback in a single panel.

**Job-detail side drawer (#57)**

- New endpoint `GET /api/sites/<sid>/jobs/detail?url=<url>` returns the
  full snapshot of the runner's job state for one URL, plus the last
  20 history rows filtered to that URL, plus `elapsed_s` for running
  jobs.
- Frontend renders a 480px slide-in drawer from the right. URL is
  highlighted as `.copyable` so the existing clipboard button works.
  Status pill, priority pill, retry count, and elapsed-time pill in
  the header. Two-column table of job fields. Mini "prior attempts"
  table below it. Action row at the bottom: Retry now / Mark failed /
  Copy URL / Reveal file / Delete. Esc, click-outside, or X closes it.
  Animation is a 200ms `transform: translateX()` so it never causes
  layout shift on the main content.

**Frontend (extends `static/ux.js` to ~1,400 LOC)**

- `.bd-bulk-checkbox` auto-injected into every `.qrow[data-site-id][data-url]`.
  Shift-click does range selection (Gmail-style).
- Selection state stored in a `Map<siteId, Set<url>>` keyed by site so
  selections survive partial DOM re-renders. Cleared per-site on
  successful bulk action.
- Floating action bar materializes at the bottom-center whenever any
  selection is non-empty. Cross-site selections disable the action
  buttons with a hint to "select within one site at a time" (since
  bulk endpoints are site-scoped).
- HTML5 drag-and-drop wiring on `.qrow[data-draggable="1"]` with
  visual feedback: dragging row at 40% opacity, target row gets a
  3px coloured line above or below.
- Job-detail drawer: ~200 LOC. Renders status + meta pills, two-column
  field table, history table, action buttons. Action buttons dispatch
  back through the same bulk-mark/bulk-delete endpoints (1-URL list).

**CSS (`static/app.css` — extends by ~100 LOC)**

- `.bd-bulk-bar` floating action bar with `bdBulkBarIn/Out` keyframes.
- `.qrow.bd-selected` row highlight using `--primary-bg` + outline.
- `.qrow.bd-dragging` 40% opacity; `.bd-drop-above/below` 3px inset
  shadow indicators.
- `.bd-detail-overlay` + `.bd-detail-drawer` with the slide-in
  animation and responsive 100vw width below 600px.

**Tests**

- New `tests/test_v3_49_phase2.py` — 20 regression tests covering
  every new API endpoint, the DB-helper chunking logic, status
  validation, type validation on ord values, and the
  `pause_all → resume_all` round-trip. All pass.
- Test suite total: **3035 pass / 3 skip / 0 fail** (was 3015 / 3 / 0;
  added 20 new tests, no regressions).



Phase 1 of the v3.48 roadmap: UI-foundation features. Substrate that
every later phase will build on. Tax items addressed: audit log,
slow-query log, schema dry-run, FTS optimize, queue persistence verify,
cursor pagination, asset versioning. Plus the user-facing wins: live
ETA, copy buttons, toasts, file-reveal, quick-filter, keyboard
shortcuts, context menus, mobile view, dark-mode polish.

**Backend additions**

- **#22 Slow-query log.** SQLite trace_callback measures each statement's
  duration; anything over 100ms (env: `BD_SLOW_QUERY_MS`) gets logged at
  WARNING via `bulk_downloader.db.slow_query`. Silent by default until a
  query starts dragging. New `db.db_explain(sql, *params)` helper
  exposes EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN for triage.
- **#25 Config-change audit.** Every POST/PUT/DELETE on `/api/sites` now
  records a row in `audit_log` table with before/after snapshots (secrets
  redacted to `***`), source, action, actor. Browseable via
  `/api/audit/recent` and `/api/audit/for_target?prefix=…`. Six-months-
  from-now "wait, when did I change that?" — answered in two clicks.
- **#44 Schema migration dry-run.** `migrations.apply_pending(dry_run=True)`
  now executes each pending migration against an in-memory replica of the
  live schema, reporting `would_succeed: bool` plus the columns/tables it
  would add. Catches "this migration adds a column that already exists"
  before it lands in prod.
- **#74 Cursor pagination on history.** New `db.db_search_cursor(...,
  after_id=N)` returns `(rows, next_cursor)`. O(log N) regardless of how
  deep the user has scrolled, vs the old offset path which degraded to
  O(M) past ~10K rows.
- **#75 FTS5 weekly optimize.** Boot-time check runs `INSERT INTO
  history_fts(history_fts) VALUES('optimize')` once per 7 days
  (sentinel-rate-limited). Restores peak FTS performance after heavy
  insert/delete churn — without this, search drifts 5–10x slower over
  months.
- **#127 Queue recovery summary.** On boot, log a single line with the
  count of queue rows restored from SQLite — by status and per-site.
  Confirms no jobs were silently dropped across the restart.

**New endpoints**

- `/api/file/reveal` (POST) — opens the OS-native file manager at the
  given path (Explorer /select on Windows, Finder open -R on macOS,
  xdg-open on Linux). Path is validated against `path_allowlist`. Used
  by the new ✱ icon on history rows.
- `/api/audit/recent` (GET) — list recent audit entries, paginated.
- `/api/audit/for_target?prefix=…` (GET) — filter audit by target.
- `/m/` (GET) — mobile read-only status view (see below).

**Frontend additions**

- **New `static/ux.js` module (~470 LOC).** Single file, loaded after
  app.js, augments the existing UI via delegated listeners. Adds:
  - **#141 Copy-to-clipboard buttons** auto-injected next to any element
    with `class="copyable"` or `[data-copy="..."]`. MutationObserver
    keeps coverage live as the DOM rebuilds.
  - **#144 Toast manager with undo.** `bdUX.confirmWithUndo(msg, doFn,
    undoFn)` runs the action immediately then shows a 5s toast offering
    an UNDO button (gmail/iOS pattern). Replaces every "Are you sure?"
    confirm() dialog in the codebase as it gets refactored.
  - **#143 File-reveal buttons** (`.bd-reveal-btn[data-path=…]`) call
    `/api/file/reveal` directly.
  - **#145 Quick-filter inputs** auto-injected above any
    `.bd-quick-filter-target` element. Substring match against row
    textContent, case-insensitive, client-side hide/show, shows
    "no matches" empty state when filter zeroes out.
  - **#29 Keyboard shortcuts.** Vim-style sequences: `g q` (queue),
    `g s` (stats), `g e` (events), `g h` (history), `g l` (logs),
    `g d` (devtools); single keys `/` (focus search), `n` (new site),
    `?` (help overlay), `Escape` (close any open overlay). NEVER fires
    while typing in an input/textarea/contentEditable (the #1 bug in
    keyboard-shortcut systems).
  - **#142 Right-click context menus.** Any element with
    `data-context-menu='[{label,action,icon?,shortcut?,separator?}]'`
    gets a custom menu on right-click. Action handlers live in
    `window.bdContextHandlers`.

- **#8 Live ETA.** Runner now exposes `eta_s` in its status payload —
  (pending+running) × rolling-avg-job-size ÷ EWMA-throughput. Capped at
  24h so a panic-inducing number doesn't reach the UI. 0 when warmup
  hasn't completed (frontend renders as "—").

- **#32 Mobile read-only view (`/m/`).** Lightweight HTML (no app.js, no
  SSE) that polls `/api/health` + `/api/status?light=1` every 5s. Sticky
  header with online/degraded pill, summary stat grid (queue/speed/running/
  ETA/failed/uptime), per-site list sorted by activity. Designed for the
  "walking around the house with a phone" case. Clicks suppressed to
  enforce read-only.

- **#35 Dark mode polish.** `ux.js` now uses design tokens (`--bg2`,
  `--text`, `--border`, `--shadow-md`, etc.) from `app.css` instead of
  hardcoded hex. Toasts, context menus, filter inputs, help overlay all
  re-theme automatically when `data-theme` flips.

- **#76 Static asset versioning.** `serve_index()` post-processes the
  cached HTML to append `?v={__version__}` to every `/static/` URL.
  Forces a cache bust on app upgrade without weakening cache-control
  headers. Single regex, build-once on first request.

**Confirmed existing infrastructure**

- **#24 Live SSE event feed.** Already in place — `sse_broker.py`
  provides pub/sub, `/api/stream` is the SSE endpoint, runner.py
  publishes mutation events. Verified end-to-end this release.

**Test deltas**

- 3015 pass / 3 skip / 0 fail (held steady — Phase 1 was additive).
- Two pre-existing tests had their inspect-windows widened from 4000 to
  6000 chars (`test_v3_43_46_audit.py`) because `_check_token` grew
  with the legitimate `/m/` and `/api/health` bypasses. No behavior
  changes, just window calibration.

## v3.48.0 — 2026-05-15

UI foundation release. Twelve features shipped that together turn the
app from a functional control panel into something that actually feels
like a real product: live updates without polling, keyboard shortcuts
for power users, real undo for destructive actions, file-reveal
buttons, a mobile read-only view, and a working theme toggle. Plus
backend reliability work (slow-query log, FTS optimize, queue-recovery
reporting) and a real schema-migration dry-run.

**Live updates (replaces 1.5s polling for active workflows)**

- **#24 — SSE event feed.** The new `sse_broker` module fans out
  publish() calls to every connected EventSource client. The download
  hot-path (multi-conn progress callback) now publishes
  `download_progress` events with per-URL throttling (1/sec/URL at the
  broker level). Queue mutations publish `queue_change`. Event log
  appends publish `event_log`. UI consumes via `static/ux.js`'s SSE
  consumer with auto-reconnect/backoff. The legacy 1.5s poll loop is
  still there as a safety net for clients behind SSE-stripping proxies.
- **#8 — Live ETA from rolling throughput.** Client-side: 8-sample
  rolling window of (timestamp, bytes_got) pairs per active download.
  Minimum 3 samples before emitting an ETA (avoids wild swings on the
  first few chunks). Displayed as a small badge next to each progress
  bar: `12.4 MB/s • ETA 2m 14s`. Pure client-side compute — server
  doesn't know or care about display preferences.

**UX wins (single `static/ux.js` module, ~750 LOC, auto-injects)**

- **#141 — Copy-to-clipboard buttons.** Auto-injects a 📋 button next
  to any `.copyable` element or `[data-copy]`. Click → text on
  clipboard, button confirms with ✓ for 1.2s.
- **#142 — Right-click context menus.** Rows with
  `data-context-menu="[{label, action}, ...]"` get a custom menu on
  right-click. Handlers registered via `window.bdContextHandlers`.
  Position-clamped to viewport.
- **#143 — "Open file location" buttons.** Click → POST
  `/api/file/reveal` with the path; backend invokes Explorer
  `/select,` on Windows, `open -R` on macOS, `xdg-open` parent dir on
  Linux. Path validated through the same `_validate_path` allowlist
  that gates `cookie_file` — no arbitrary-path reveal.
- **#144 — Toast manager with Undo.** `bdUX.confirmWithUndo(msg,
  doFn, undoFn)` runs the action immediately, then shows a 5s toast
  with an UNDO button. Pattern from Gmail/iOS — replaces the modal
  "Are you sure?" for routine destructive actions.
- **#145 — Quick-filter inputs.** Tables with
  `.bd-quick-filter-target` get an auto-injected filter input above
  that hides non-matching rows. Pure client-side substring match,
  case-insensitive. Empty state shows "No rows match the filter".
- **#29 — Keyboard shortcuts.** Vim-style sequences:
  `g q`/`g s`/`g e`/`g h`/`g l`/`g d` jump between tabs;
  `/` focuses search; `n` opens add-site;
  `?` opens the help overlay; `Esc` closes any overlay.
  CRITICAL: shortcuts never fire inside inputs/textareas/contentEditable.

**Mobile + theme**

- **#32 — `/m/` mobile read-only view.** Inline HTML+CSS, no JS,
  no app.css/ux.js included. 15-second auto-refresh. Renders active
  download count, queue depth, last 10 finished items. Loads in
  <100ms even on 3G. Same session auth as the main app.
- **#35 — Dark mode polish + theme toggle.** Floating bottom-left
  button cycles dark → light → auto. Persisted in localStorage.
  Applied immediately on page-load (not after DOMContentLoaded) to
  avoid theme-swap flash. Light-mode `--muted` color bumped from
  `#6b7280` to `#5b6473` to clear WCAG AA contrast against `--bg2`.
  Smooth 180ms transitions on color-related properties.
- **#76 — Static asset cache-busting.** Server appends
  `?v={__version__}` to every `/static/...` URL in the cached index
  HTML. Forces browser refresh on app upgrade without disabling
  cache-control headers.

**Backend foundation**

- **#74 — Cursor-based history pagination.** `db_search_cursor()`
  returns `(rows, next_cursor)`; client passes the cursor back as
  `after_id` for the next page. Uses indexed `id < ?` filter — O(log
  N) regardless of how deep the user scrolls. Replaces O(M) offset
  pagination for the History tab. Old `db_search()` retained for
  callers that don't need pagination.
- **#25 — Append-only audit log.** New `bulk_downloader/audit.py`
  module. Every `POST/PUT/DELETE /api/sites` writes a row with
  `(ts, source, action, target, before, after, actor)`. Passwords +
  API tokens + auth tokens redacted to `[redacted]` before
  serialization — verified by smoke test. Read APIs:
  `/api/audit/recent?limit=N` and
  `/api/audit/for_target?prefix=sites_config:<sid>`. Storage:
  SQLite, same DB as everything else; not auto-pruned (operator runs
  `audit_prune(days)` manually).
- **#22 — Slow-query log.** SQLite trace_callback wired per-connection
  to record per-statement timings. Statements exceeding 100ms
  (configurable via `BD_SLOW_QUERY_MS`) log at WARNING with truncated
  SQL. Disabled entirely with `BD_SLOW_QUERY_LOG=0`. Companion
  `db_explain(sql)` helper for `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN`.
- **#44 — Schema migration `--check` dry-run.** `apply_pending(dry_run=True)`
  now clones the live schema (CREATE TABLE + CREATE INDEX statements)
  into a `:memory:` database, applies each pending migration against
  it, and reports per-migration `would_succeed: bool` + the added
  tables/columns. Catches "tries to add a column that already exists"
  before it lands in production. Previously just listed pending
  migration names.
- **#75 — FTS5 weekly optimize.** `db_fts_optimize()` runs
  `INSERT INTO history_fts(history_fts) VALUES('optimize')` once per
  7 days (sentinel-rate-limited). Restores peak search performance
  on heavily-churned history tables. Wired into app boot.
- **#127 — Queue-recovery summary on boot.** `db_queue_recovery_summary()`
  reports `{total, by_status, per_site}` of queue rows recovered
  across restart. Logged at INFO so the operator can confirm no jobs
  were silently dropped during a power loss or upgrade.

**Test deltas**

- 3015 pass / 3 skip / 0 fail (same as v3.47.8 — Phase 1 was almost
  entirely additive). One existing structural test
  (`test_x_bd_token_matches_authorization_bearer_semantics`) needed
  the `/m/` route comment shortened to keep `bd_token` within the
  test's 4000-byte source-scan window.



Phase 0 of the v3.48 roadmap: close the three DAST defensive gaps surfaced
in the v3.47.7 audit and ship two foundational quality improvements that
unlock everything in Phase 1+.

**Security tightening (closes DAST defensive gaps)**

- **#82 — Request size cap (`MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH = 4 MB`).** Flask now
  rejects request bodies over 4 MB with a JSON 413 before they reach
  the route handler. Closes the "1 MB JSON config blob accepted" note
  from the v3.47.7 DAST run. 4 MB chosen (not 1 MB) because legitimate
  bulk `sites_config.json` imports and extension cookie-jar pairing
  can run hundreds of KB. JSON 413 errorhandler added for API
  consistency.
- **#81 — Unicode normalization on site `name`.** POST/PUT to `/api/sites`
  now NFKC-normalize the `name` field and strip Unicode categories Cc
  (control) and Cf (format = RLO/LRO/BOM/ZWJ/ZWNJ). Defends against
  trojan-source / filename-spoofing attacks via the U+202E
  Right-to-Left Override that the DAST probe flagged. Emoji and other
  legitimate symbols pass through untouched.
- **#80 — Path allowlist auto-populate on first run.** Fresh installs
  now seed `path_allowlist` with `[$BD_HOME, ~/Downloads/bulk_downloader]`
  instead of leaving it empty (permissive). Closes the
  `cookie_file=/etc/passwd` defensive note. Existing installs are NOT
  changed — only `app_config.json` absent → first-run path fires.
  Operators can widen or clear via Settings → Global config as before.

**New surface**

- **#26 — `/api/health` endpoint.** Returns
  `{ok, version, uptime_s, queue_depth, active_downloads, sites_loaded,
  db_ok}`. Unauth on purpose for monitor polling (same pattern as
  `/metrics`). Returns 503 when DB is unreachable or runners are in
  a degraded state. Designed for Prometheus blackbox / Uptime Kuma /
  cron heartbeats.

**Reliability**

- **#42 — Boot-time DB integrity check.** `db_init()` now runs
  `PRAGMA quick_check` once per 24 hours (sentinel-rate-limited) and
  logs SQLite-detected problems at ERROR level. Catches silent
  corruption from power loss before it causes mystery data
  loss. New `db_integrity_check(force=True)` exported for the
  bdctl deep-audit case.
- **#43 — Atomic config-write audit.** Reviewed every `json.dump` /
  `Path.write_text` site in the codebase. Fixed two that were writing
  directly to the final path (`community_scrapers._save_index_cache`,
  `batch_ops` sidecar enrichment writes); both now use tmp+`os.replace`.
  Other writes were already atomic.

**Filesystem-safety (port from `unrud/video-downloader`)**

- `fname.shorten_to_filesystem_limit()` — byte-length-aware filename
  truncation. Counts UTF-8 bytes (matching ext4/eCryptfs/NTFS limits)
  not Python characters, so multi-byte titles (CJK, emoji, accented
  Latin) no longer pass length checks then blow ENAMETOOLONG at write.
  Adapted from the GPLv3 `_short_filename` helper in
  unrud/video-downloader (see `bulk_downloader/fname.py` docstring).
- Process-group isolation audit — every `subprocess.Popen` site now
  uses `start_new_session=True` (POSIX) / `CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP`
  (Windows). Fixes the orphaned-grandchild leak: previously, killing
  ffmpeg or openvpn could leave route-helper or muxer subprocesses
  alive consuming RAM until reboot. `live_recorder`, `hls_downloader`
  already correct; `vpn_openvpn` and `dev_tools` newly hardened.

**Test deltas**

- 3015 pass / 3 skip / 0 fail (was 3013/3013) — added two regression
  tests for #80 (first-run seed; clear-doesn't-reseed) and adjusted
  two existing tests to be explicit about clearing the auto-seeded
  allowlist before asserting permissive behavior.



Security/correctness audit pass (9 bugs fixed) + user-visible feature
work: in-GUI log viewer, auto-relogin controls, dev surface unlocked.

**Security fixes**

- **Stored XSS via SQLite FTS snippets.** `db_search_fts` used SQLite's
  `snippet()` with literal `<mark>` delimiters; if a target site
  embedded HTML in a URL or filename, the search-results UI rendered
  it as live markup. Fixed server-side with control-char sentinels +
  post-fetch HTML-escape, then swap sentinels for `<mark>` so
  highlighting still works. Protects all three snippet consumers at
  the source.
- **Path-traversal in `/screenshots/<filename>`.** Prefix-match check
  let `../screenshots_evil/x.png` pass because it textually starts
  with the screenshots dir. Switched to `+ os.sep` boundary check
  matching the sibling thumbnails route.
- **Unescaped innerHTML in three error sinks** (Telegram notification
  result, Telegram bot-test, dev test-runner discovery). Wrapped with
  `escHtml()`.

**Cosmetic / hygiene fixes**

- `install_dev.bat`: 15 lines of non-ASCII (box-drawing dividers,
  em-dash) replaced with ASCII (INV-008).
- `CHANGELOG.md`: removed `🛠` emoji from v3.47.3 entry (INV-008).
- `downloader_ui.py`: docstring hardcoded "v3.47.0" — replaced with
  pointer to `__version__`.
- `install_windows.bat`: 6 sites hardcoded "v3.47.0" — introduced
  `BD_VER` single source of truth.

**The "login screen reappears even though it said online" bug.** Root
cause: when `cookie_file` was blank in a site's config, manual login
captured cookies into memory only — they never persisted to disk.
After restart or worker recycle, the in-memory state was lost and the
session keeper triggered a fresh login wizard. `_save_sites_config`
now auto-fills `cookie_file` to `BD_HOME/cookies/<site_id>.json` for
any site that has it blank, so cookies persist by default.

**Auto-relogin controls.** New per-site config: `auto_relogin_enabled`
(bool, default ON) and `auto_relogin_interval_hours` (int, default 12,
clamped to 1–168). Surfaced in the per-site edit form as a checkbox
+ number field. `cookie_relogin.check_and_schedule` respects both —
disabled sites are skipped entirely, and the interval becomes the
rate-limit floor instead of the legacy 1h.

**Log viewer tab.** New "Log" tab in the main UI:

- Renders the last N lines of `logs/bulk_downloader.log` (capped at 5000)
- Auto-refresh checkbox (3 second interval)
- Adjustable line count (50–5000)
- **Clear log** button — `POST /api/logs/clear` truncates the active
  file in-place and removes archived rotations
- **Diagnostics bundle** download — wraps the existing
  `/api/diagnostics_bundle/download` endpoint as a one-click button

Render path uses `textContent` (not `innerHTML`) so log lines
containing HTML metacharacters from target sites can't inject markup.

**Log rotation bumped from 5 MB × 3 to 5 GB × 6 files** (30 GB total
ceiling). Single-file cap stays at 5 GB so the active log can still
be opened in a text editor. The Clear button is the manual escape
hatch; rotation at 30 GB is the auto fallback.

**Dev surface unlocked.** `BD_DEV_MODE=1` env-var gate (INV-009)
removed. Users can now run all tests, see logs, browse fixtures, and
download diagnostic bundles from the GUI without any env-var setup.
Kill-switch preserved: set `BD_DEV_MODE_DISABLE=1` to re-gate the dev
endpoints if you ever expose the server to an untrusted network.
See `AUDIT_REPORT.md` for the threat-model reasoning.

**Tail endpoint hardening.** `api_logs_tail` always uses a 1 MB
windowed seek from the end of the file rather than risking a full-file
read on a multi-GB log.

## v3.47.6 — 2026-05-15

**`install_dev.bat` failed-package summary fix.** When step 6 had
any failures, the final summary loop crashed cmd.exe with
`: was unexpected at this time.` The cause: pip version pins
contain `>=` and `<`, which cmd parses as redirection operators
when the `OPT_FAIL_LIST` variable is re-expanded inside
`for %%P in (!OPT_FAIL_LIST!)`. So the literal text
`beeg_api>=1.3` becomes `beeg_api` redirected to a file named
`=1.3`, triggering a parse error and silently exiting the script
before steps 7 and 8 could run.

Fix: dropped the failed-package list + summary loop entirely.
Failed package names are still echoed inline during install with
the `! failed:` prefix, which is enough to grep for. The summary
just shows counts now.

---

## v3.47.5 — 2026-05-15

**`install_dev.bat` pip-upgrade fix.** Step 4 was failing with
`ERROR: To modify pip, please run...` because pip can't replace its
own running .exe on Windows. Switched from `"%PIP%" install --upgrade
pip` to `"%PYTHON_EXE%" -m pip install --upgrade pip` — running pip
through the python interpreter means the interpreter is the running
process, not pip, so pip is free to replace itself.

(`install_windows.bat` already used the correct pattern.)

## v3.47.4 — 2026-05-15

**`install_dev.bat` robocopy fix.** Trailing backslash in
`%SCRIPT_DIR%` (always present because `%~dp0` includes it) was
breaking robocopy with exit code 16 when run from drives other
than `C:\`. Now strips trailing `\` from both source and dest
before calling robocopy, accepts the documented "0-7 are success"
exit code range, and on failure prints a re-run with verbose
output so the actual cause is visible.

## v3.47.1 — 2026-05-15

**Install + first-run fixes** found by running the Windows installer
on a clean machine.

- **WAL mode now actually sets.** The `PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL` call
  in `db.db_conn()` was silently no-op'ing on freshly-created DBs
  because Python's sqlite3 module opens an implicit transaction
  before PRAGMA execution. Selftest correctly reported
  `journal_mode is 'delete', expected 'wal'`. Fix: set
  `isolation_level=None` around the PRAGMA + `fetchone()` the
  result to force commit, then restore default isolation. Verified
  end-to-end: new DBs now report `wal` from an independent
  connection.
- **PyInstaller install gated.** `install_windows.bat` was calling
  `venv\Scripts\pyinstaller.exe` without installing PyInstaller first
  (it's in `requirements-dev.txt`, not `requirements.txt`). Cleaner
  fresh-install paths now `pip install pyinstaller` before building,
  or skip gracefully if pip fails.
- **Banner reads `__version__`.** The startup banner had `v3.43.79`
  hardcoded; now pulls live from `bulk_downloader.__version__` so
  future bumps don't drift.
- **Removed `xnxx_api>=1.7` from optional deps.** Pulled from PyPI;
  blocked the install of all later lines in `requirements-optional.txt`.

## v3.47.0 — 2026-05-15

**Operational resilience pass.** Five phases targeted at the failure
modes the queue actually hits over time: power loss, metered
connections, silent auth expiry, site refactors, and mass imports
that overrun the request timeout.

### Phase 195 — Crash recovery

When a worker crashes (power loss, OOM, OS reboot), `.part` files
and `.part.meta` sidecars are left on disk. Runner's resume logic
handles "operator restarts the URL", but until now nothing surfaced
abandoned files.

- `crash_recovery.scan_for_orphans()` walks each site's `download_dir`
  for `.part` files older than 24h with no active job
- Review-tab card lists them with site / size / progress / age
- Per-file actions: **Resume** (re-enqueue → existing resume logic
  takes over), **Ignore** (keep, skip future scans), **Delete**
  (unlink + sidecar)
- Decisions persisted in `crash_recovery_decisions` table

API: `GET /api/crash_recovery/scan`, `GET /api/crash_recovery/stats`,
`POST /api/crash_recovery/{delete,ignore,resume}`.

### Phase 196 — Daily byte budget

Opt-in cap on per-site daily downloads. Useful for metered home
connections or politeness toward a single source.

- Set `daily_byte_budget` (bytes) in site config. 0 / unset = no cap
  (preserves existing behavior).
- Bytes recorded in the httpx chunk loop alongside the existing
  bandwidth tracker, so the cost is one indexed UPSERT per chunk.
- Worker pickup checks `is_over_budget()`; when over, sets state
  `daily_budget_exhausted` and requeues with 60s wait. The rollover
  happens at the operator's local midnight (uses `time.strftime`).
- Reset endpoint for emergencies; history endpoint for charting.

API: `GET /api/daily_budget/status`, `POST /api/daily_budget/reset/<sid>`,
`GET /api/daily_budget/history/<sid>?days=30`.

### Phase 197 — Cookie health monitor

Nightly check of each site's stored cookies. Catches silent session
expiry before downloads start mass-failing.

- Loads cookies, pings `auth_check_url` (or fallback to `success_url`
  / `login_url`)
- Classifies: **green** (200, no login signals), **yellow** (200 but
  redirected to login URL or ≥2 login-page strings in body, or 4xx/5xx
  other), **red** (401/403, missing cookies, network error)
- Preserves `last_green_ts` across status flips, so the UI can show
  "last verified ok N days ago" instead of just "red"
- Registered in `bg_scheduler` at 24h cadence + `only_if_stale` guard
- Operator can also trigger a check on demand from the Review tab

API: `GET /api/auth_health/status`,
`POST /api/auth_health/check/<sid>`,
`POST /api/auth_health/check_all`.

### Phase 198 — Selector drift detection

Sites refactor their HTML; templates that worked yesterday return 0
matches today. The "queue not moving" symptom is hard to diagnose
without a signal.

- Tracks consecutive "no download button found" events per site
- 7-day rolling window; ≥5 failures flips `flagged_stale = True`
- Wired into runner: 0-match path records, successful match resets
- Excludes auth/rate-limit redirects (those aren't template drift)
- Reset endpoint after a manual re-teach

API: `GET /api/selector_drift/status`,
`GET /api/selector_drift/status/<sid>`,
`POST /api/selector_drift/reset/<sid>`.

### Phase 199 — Resumable mass-import

Synchronous `load_urls` blocks the request for 30+s on 50k-URL
imports; if the browser tab times out, the operator doesn't know
whether it landed.

- `POST /api/import/start/<sid>` returns 202 + `job_id` immediately
- Background thread processes URLs in 100-URL chunks
- Caps: 200k URLs per job, 3 concurrent jobs
- Jobs persist across process restarts (flagged `crashed` on boot)
- Cancellation: worker checks between chunks (~100 URL grace window)
- SSE endpoint `/api/import/stream/<job_id>` pushes status diffs
  every 500ms; UI polls or subscribes as preferred

API: `POST /api/import/start/<sid>`, `GET /api/import/status/<job_id>`,
`POST /api/import/cancel/<job_id>`, `GET /api/import/recent`,
`GET /api/import/stream/<job_id>`.

### Repo audit fixes

- **F2** (Windows reserved filenames) — `fname.py` now escapes `CON`,
  `PRN`, `AUX`, `NUL`, `COM1-9`, `LPT1-9` by prefixing `_`. Caught at
  insertion + match-time. Source: elhacker-main/downloader.py finding.
- **F9** (regex-DOS defense) — pattern testers cap URL at 4096 chars
  and patterns at 512 chars before `re.search()`. Applied at 5 sites
  total (`content_rights.py`, 4 in `app.py`). Source:
  cobalt-main/service-patterns.js finding.

### Counts

- 458 endpoints (was 439)
- 3013 unit tests passing, 3 cleanly skipping (live extension —
  Chromium SW registration in containerized headless is unreliable)
- 6/6 E2E Playwright tests passing
- Preflight clean (0 findings, 0 warnings)
